item.title: llama.cpp b12233–b12239 releases
item.description:
发表方：llama.cpp (GitHub Releases)　发布：2026-11-10　分类：技术博客 / 每日精选

核心话题 llama.cpp 连续版本发布（b12233–b12239）的更新要点汇总，覆盖推理引擎的修复、API 增强与平台支持扩展。

要点 各版本亮点：修复 Hexagon 后端 64 位 FastRPC 句柄关闭截断问题；server responses API 支持 text.format.json_schema 到 completions 的转换；聊天在设置 tools 时 response_format 不再使用 lazy grammar 等。发布矩阵涵盖 macOS（Apple Silicon/Intel/iOS）、Linux（CPU/ARM 多架构、CUDA 12/13、ROCm、Vulkan、SYCL、OpenVINO、Snapdragon 等）、Windows 与 Android 多后端。

关键数字 文本未给出性能数字；更新集中在正确性修复与 API 兼容性。

为什么值得看 llama.cpp 是本地 LLM 推理的事实标准引擎，跟踪版本节奏与平台覆盖对自部署用户最实用。

item.title: When Can You Trust Neural Critics? Auditing Mutual Information Estimates of Higher-Order Epistasis in Protein Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Mutual information (MI) estimation is used to probe what neural representations encode, including in protein language models, but variational MI estimators have variance that scales at least exponentially in the true MI. We audit a prior neural-MI study of order-resolved epistasis in ESM-2 on the four-site GB1 landscape. Run-to-run differences show no systematic bias and a magnitude comparable to ordinary cross-seed retraining variability, and the evaluation-pairing scheme shifts scores substantially. At the original dimensionality, two of three alternative estimator families stabilize the estimate across seeds and one does not. In a synthetic calibration at the representation dimensionalities of two other protein language models (a Gaussian channel with known MI; no model representations), all three families recover materially less signal than required, despite correct signal ordering and stable seeds. A control critic given the true signal direction, which also reduces its input to one dimension, recovers 93.3% and 98.7% of the analytic MI at gain 1.5 (at 5,120 and 4,096 dimensions), so the signal is recoverable with privileged information, but the control does not identify why b…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: What Matters for LLM Persona Simulation: Signal Form in Cold-Start E-Commerce Advertising
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Estimating advertising performance in cold-start settings is challenging because historical logs are unavailable before launch. Large language models (LLMs) offer a potential alternative by simulating persona-conditioned user responses, but it remains unclear which design choices actually drive LLM-based persona simulation. Using real Google Ads e-commerce campaign data across five demographic segments, we identify three signal-form dimensions that affect simulation quality: (i) a demographic anchor without noisy rich attributes, (ii) a relative qualitative banner-blindness signal rather than quantitative anchors, and (iii) prompt phrasing. On this campaign, our method attains an MAE of 24.9 and a MAPE of 26.1%, a 51.3% lower MAE than the best tested non-LLM baseline and 77.3% lower than an LLM configuration using explicit CTR anchors. Systematic ablations show that minimal demographic descriptions achieve lower mean error than richer persona configurations, while relative qualitative cues substantially outperform the tested quantitative anchors. We additionally compare these configurations with direct-prior and rule-based baselines and with alternative LLM configurations.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Verifier Noise Is a Temperature: Testing Tilt Predictions in Finite-Budget LLM-Guided Search
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

LLM-guided search loops propose a modified candidate, score it, and keep it if it scores better. When both candidates are re-scored at every comparison, as in the minibatch acceptance gates of prompt optimizers, keep-if-better is a reversible Markov chain if the score difference is logistic and the mutation operator is reversible, and its stationary law is the mutation equilibrium tilted by exp(beta f). For any continuous symmetric noise difference the same tilt is the stationary law of a small-step diffusion limit, with beta = 4F'(0); for a minibatch gate beta grows with the square root of the minibatch size. Caching the incumbent's score instead inflates the recorded score. We test the tilt as a prediction for LLM-guided program search, committing each prediction from calibration data before the search runs. The level after 150 steps rises with the minibatch size in six of seven settings, but its predicted value fails: on bin packing, search attains 62-88% of the predicted gain when the proposer edits the parent and 109-119% when it writes new heuristics. The attained fraction falls with the parent-child quality correlation of unselected mutation; a registered test on two new set…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: UniExit: A Unified Latency-Aware Early-Exit Runtime for Heterogeneous Edge AI
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：边缘应用日益把 CNN 感知与可边缘部署的 Transformer 语言模型结合，但推理延迟随输入难度与运行时硬件状态变化，静态早退策略在动态边缘条件下过时——如何统一且延迟感知地控制？

方法：UniExit：把 CNN 块与 Transformer 层抽象为有序 stage，施加统一的延迟感知路由策略（保留模型特定质量机制）；结合运行时状态感知延迟预测、缓存化预测复用、趋势感知回退与 CNN 特定退出稳定化，做预算感知的 continue-or-exit 决策。

关键数字：在多个边缘与边缘-云平台实现并评估；单工作负载、并发异构与边缘-云场景下均持续改善 deadline 满足率与延迟-准确率权衡（原文未给出统一量化数值）。

为什么值得看：异构边缘 AI 在线自适应早退运行时，兼顾低开销、鲁棒与节能。

item.title: TwinHash: Two-Sided Object Identity Management for Time- and Energy-Efficient Agentic Workflows
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Agentic artificial intelligence (AI) services interleave large language model (LLM) generation with external tool execution, and increasingly rely on search-based workflows that repeatedly revisit shared reasoning states and computations. These patterns create substantial redundancy across tool outputs, LLM responses, and key-value (KV) prefixes, yet existing serving systems primarily optimize shared prompt prefixes, while naive input-keyed caching is unsafe when identical requests produce different outputs. We present TwinHash, a unified object management architecture that assigns each object an input-side hash key to recognize repeated requests and an output-side content fingerprint to validate and locate stored state, complemented by type-specific reuse guards that preserve correctness and response diversity. A software object identity table maintains reusable objects across requests and trajectories, while a hardware object placement table tracks their residency across hierarchical memory tiers so that evicted state can be retrieved rather than recomputed. Across seven agent frameworks and five benchmark suites, reuse follows workflow structure more than benchmark identity. Twi…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Transformer-FSQ: Discrete Latents for Extreme KV-Cache Compression
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：本地消费设备上 KV cache 随上下文线性增长、迅速超过模型本身——现有压缩方法在中等压缩比之外失效，如何实现极端 KV cache 压缩？

方法：Transformer-FSQ：用有限标量量化（FSQ）瓶颈替换标准 key/value 投影，每 token 存打包的离散整数码向量、无逐 token 量化元数据；转换预训练模型只需训练这些投影（每原始参数 0.25 token）；融合 Triton kernel 直接从整数码解码。

关键数字：Qwen3-1.7B-Base 保留 20 万条目需 21 GiB（模型权重的 6.6 倍）；RULER 长上下文检索上 12×–97.5× 压缩为评估中最准方法；Qwen3-8B-Base 在 32× 压缩时解码吞吐为原生 SDPA 的 1.01×、97.5× 时 1.54×。

为什么值得看：极端 KV 压缩让固定设备可容纳的上下文大幅延长，端侧个性化模型直接受益。

item.title: Towards Sustainable Federated Learning via Carbon-Aware Client Selection
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

The Information/Communication Technology (ICT) industry is severely challenging the global environment due to the sharply rising carbon emissions generated by machine learning (ML) workloads. Federated Learning (FL) is one of the prominent distributed ML systems used in applications with billions of client devices, such as Google Gboard and Apple Siri. Nearly half of the total carbon footprint in FL originates from client-side computation during local training. However, existing client selection strategies in FL primarily focus on minimizing energy consumption rather than carbon emissions, despite the fact that carbon impact depends not only on computational load but also on the underlying carbon intensity of the energy source. In this paper, we address this gap by proposing a carbon-aware fair client selection strategy (CA-FCS) designed to minimize the carbon emissions associated with model training on client devices. In contrast to existing approaches for reducing carbon emissions in FL, we incorporate hourly carbon intensity and a realistic energy consumption model developed using empirical measurements from Google Pixel smartphones to estimate client-side carbon emissions in FL…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Topology as a Design Variable: Joint Architecture-Sizing Optimization for SRAM
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：SRAM 的功耗-性能-面积-稳定性权衡取决于 bitcell topology 这一离散架构选择，且与连续晶体管尺寸不可分离地交互——但开源 SRAM 工具都不把 topology 当作可优化变量。

方法：OpenYieldV2 三项贡献：全参数化编译器生成完整的 6T/10T SRAM 宏（含外围电路与 replica-bitline 自定时，保证同条件下可比）；few-shot TabPFN 代理模型用少量全宏 SPICE 样本学习 topology 相关 PPA 响应；粗到细多目标优化器联合探索离散拓扑选择与连续尺寸微调。

关键数字：实验显示拓扑决策边界随工作条件约束移动而非固定设计规则；跨该边界联合优化相对最强单拓扑基线 hypervolume 最高提升 17.3%。

为什么值得看：SRAM 设计自动化把 topology 提升为一等设计变量的开源工具链。

item.title: The Cost of Coverage: Conformalising Native Forecast Uncertainty for GB Wind Power
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Uncertainty bands on wind forecasts help inform reserve sizing and commitments, but often fail to deliver their stated coverage. We apply conformal prediction to native bands to see what it adds and what it costs, comparing six forecasters, from ARIMA to a tabular foundation model, at two wind farms in Great Britain (GB) under operational conditions. We show that calibration repairs empirical marginal coverage with little or no Winkler Score penalty, but this apparent success conceals under-coverage in high winds. Calibrating by forecast wind regime turns marginal coverage into regime-level coverage, cutting day-ahead out-of-band volume in high winds by over 40% relative to pooled calibration while narrowing bands overall.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Speed Up Image Generation with FLUX 3 Image Klein on NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs
item.description:
发表方：NVIDIA Technical Blog　发布：2026-11-06　分类：技术博客 / 每日精选

核心话题：扩散模型图像生成的推理延迟是设计工具/编辑器的部署瓶颈，如何在 Blackwell 上加速 FLUX 3 Image Klein。

要点：TensorRT LLM VisualGen 运行时组合优化：FlashInfer PrimsTS FP8/NVFP4 GEMM kernel、epilogue 融合、低精度与稀疏注意力、缓存、多 GPU 并行；支持 BFL 预量化 NVFP4 checkpoint；2048×2048 单 B200 基准，附部署说明与 YAML 配置。

item.title: Solver-Free Decision-Focused Learning via Neural Optimization Layers for Edge Selection
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Decision-focused learning trains prediction models to improve downstream decisions, but many methods require costly solver calls or optimal-solution labels. We propose a solver-free decision-focused learning framework for NP-hard edge-selection problems with uncertain parameters in the objective, the constraints, or both. A neural optimization layer is first trained without solution labels, using problem objectives and constraint penalties. Graph-informed edge scoring and iterative refinement encourage concentrated and structurally consistent continuous decisions. The layer is then frozen, and a prediction model is trained through its continuous output using a problem-specific loss evaluated under observed parameters. At deployment, the predictor, optimization layer, and a lightweight decoder produce decisions without solving the original NP-hard problem. Experiments on the asymmetric traveling salesperson and endpoint-free orienteering problems show consistently better decision quality than prediction-focused learning and improvements over most evaluated decision-focused baselines. Our framework requires less training time than the evaluated decision-focused baselines, even when o…

item.title: Scaling Graph Similarity Learning with Graph Neural Networks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Graph similarity computation is an important task in graph mining with many real-world applications, such as chemical compound analysis, program dependence comparison, and social network analysis. The problem is computationally challenging: Graph Edit Distance (GED) and Maximum Common Subgraph (MCS), which quantify the distance between graphs and identify their largest shared subgraph, respectively, are NP-hard to compute exactly. To address these computational challenges, Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have been applied to this problem. However, existing GNN-based approaches have primarily focused on small-scale graph datasets, while scalability to larger scales remains underexplored. In this work, we propose FiLSim, a scalable GNN-based framework, and investigate whether a simplified GNN pipeline can maintain competitive performance on standard benchmarks while scaling to large graphs. We additionally propose a sequential graph-editing strategy to construct large-scale graph datasets with reliable GED labels to evaluate scalability. The proposed framework is evaluated on four benchmark datasets and four newly created large-scale datasets, demonstrating its effectiveness and scalabi…

item.title: RidgeFill: Training-Free Late-Layer Cache Fill for Faster Prefill
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：prefill 阶段为 prompt 计算模型大部分上层是否必要——能否跳过上层直接填充 KV cache 以缩短 prefill？

方法：RidgeFill：下层精确运行到 split 层，从 split 层状态出发用逐层映射（对校准文本单趟闭式拟合的 ridge regression）预测每个后续层的输入，各后层从该预测写 cache；无训练、不丢 token，给定行、最后几千 token 与每个解码步仍跑完整模型。

关键数字：Qwen3.8-27B（llama.cpp fork、A100）在 16K–120K token 下 TTFT 快 1.25–1.31×，RULER 变化 -1.2/-1.4 点、LongBench v2 -1.4；Qwen3.8-Flash-Next（vLLM）在 9K–32K token 下比精确计算快 1.50–1.60×，RULER needle 任务 99.8 对 100.0。

为什么值得看：免训练给已发布模型加 prefill 加速，兼容 llama.cpp/vLLM 现有推理栈。

item.title: Rethinking MoE Load Balancing as Feedback Control
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) training is often not stationary: the data mixture changes at curriculum boundaries, when a model is continually pretrained into a new domain, or when the corpus is refreshed. Routing is learned against the current mixture, so each such change disrupts the per-expert load the router had converged to, and existing balancing methods have only been evaluated on stationary data. We rethink load balancing as a feedback control problem, in which the deviation of each expert's load from its fair share is the control error and the per-expert routing bias is the control input, and define a family of controllers, the PID-Balancer, from the proportional, integral, and derivative terms of classical PID control. Two widely used methods belong to this family: the auxiliary balancing loss behaves like a proportional controller, and the loss-free bias update is an integral controller acting on the sign of the error. Reading the router as a static map with a one-step delay, we show that the integral term is the only one that both removes persistent imbalance and averages out the step-to-step fluctuation of the measured load, whereas the proportional and derivative terms pas…

item.title: ResQAdam: Residual-Preserving Adaptive Optimization for Memory-Efficient Quantization Aware Training
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：量化感知训练（QAT）是获得低比特 LLM 的最可靠途径，但 AdamW 为每个权重矩阵保留两个稠密 FP32 状态；低秩内存高效优化器（GaLore、LDAdam）在 QAT 中明显退化——如何保留被投影丢弃的动量残差？

方法：ResQAdam：只保留单个 BF16 momentum，仅对主子空间的 r×r 坐标应用 Adam，对残差施加归一化符号更新（观察到残差仅保留符号仍有用）。

关键数字：两个从零 QAT 方法与三个 QAT 微调流水线（权重量化到 2 bit）上，相对 AdamW 优化器状态内存降低 71–74%，多数设置精度保持接近 AdamW，训练吞吐下降小于 2%。

为什么值得看：QAT 场景下"内存高效优化器精度不崩"的新解，低比特训练直接受益。

item.title: Reliable Prerequisite-Aware Learning Path Recommendation under Uncertain Knowledge Structures: Long-Horizon Evaluation and Cross-Dataset Validation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Learning-path recommendation often depends on knowledge and prerequisite structures whose reliability is uncertain, while high accuracy in predicting the next resource does not necessarily establish reliable long-horizon path behaviour. This study develops a reliability-oriented prerequisite-aware framework that jointly examines immediate next-resource ranking, uncertain prerequisite structures, hard, soft and hybrid constraint semantics, graph robustness, and autoregressive path generation under course-level confirmatory evaluation and independent cross-dataset validation. Development used 3,187 MOOCCubeX courses, followed by a frozen confirmatory evaluation on 541 held-out courses and 37,747 transitions. The primary MOOCCubeX task is structural and course-prefix-conditioned rather than learner-personalised. Junyi provides independent structure-/hierarchy-aware external validation, uses hierarchy metadata rather than an explicit prerequisite graph and is not a zero-shot transfer setting. On the frozen MOOCCubeX evaluation, XGBoost pairwise was the strongest observed immediate ranker, with mean reciprocal rank (MRR) of 0.9048, whereas the proposed prerequisite-aware graph model ach…

item.title: Reconstructing LLM Lineage Trees via Fine-Tuning Path Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Fine-tuned (FT) derivatives of large language models (LLMs) are now released in large numbers, yet their provenance relies on self-reports and cannot be verified. Misattributed lineage leaves a verifier unable to audit outsourced fine-tuning, confirm license compliance of derived models, or trace vulnerabilities that a parent passes to its children. All three require the direction of derivation, not merely its presence. Existing output-only methods are limited to pairwise derivation tests or undirected lineage estimation, while recovering a directed tree requires white-box access to model weights. We formalize the problem of reconstructing a directed model tree, including internal nodes, under gray-box access, where only teacher-forced log-likelihoods are observed and weights are never inspected. Fine-tuning raises the log-likelihood of the training data, and a child inherits this increase from its parent. Building on this property, we define an asymmetric per-task log-likelihood deviation between any two models as a trace of fine-tuning history, and derive from it an edge weight for each ordered pair of models. We propose TRACE-Edge, which exactly solves for the maximum spanning d…

item.title: RPEG: Training Reasoning Language Models Scalably and Cost-Effectively
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：RL 已成为训练推理模型（RLM）的核心，但流水线多模型耦合、阶段异构、跨步状态与复杂异步依赖使其难扩展、成本高——如何联合优化流水线结构与执行？

方法：RPEG：数据中心的图中间表示，暴露有界异步、actor-critic 共享等结构选择，以及阶段融合、细粒度调度、多维模型并行等执行优化；配套联合刻画计算/通信/内存与 rack/node/GPU 层级效应的分析性能模型。

关键数字：最高 256 张 GH200 的系统上，相对 ReaL 性能最高提升 2×，相对 verl 步延迟最高降低 2.48×，硬件利用率最高提高 30%。

为什么值得看：推理模型 RL 训练流水线的图驱动基础架构，为前沿推理 LLM 训练提供新底座。

item.title: One Run Is Not Enough: A Monte Carlo Protocol for Evaluating LLM Reliability on Data Science Tasks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise for automating data science workflows. Benchmarks such as DataSciBench (2026) and StatQA (2024) have advanced the evaluation of their capabilities across data science and statistical tasks. Assessing their reliability requires examining both the quality of their responses and their consistency across repeated runs, task types, and difficulty levels. With this aim, we introduce DS-QA, a benchmark comprising 100 data science and statistics questions drawn from UK university courses, spanning 16 datasets and three difficulty levels. We develop a three-layer evaluation framework that combines general response properties (runtime, verbosity and text similarity), coarse-grained metrics (accuracy, code executability and completeness), and task-specific metrics. We evaluate OpenAI models using a Monte Carlo protocol with 100 repeated runs. The results reveal substantial variability in responses to data visualisation and supervised learning tasks, particularly at medium and hard difficulty levels, highlighting the importance of evaluating consistency alongside response quality. item.title: Nebula: Distributed Position-Independent Caching for LLM Serving
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Modern LLM workflows, such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and LLM agents, build long prompts from multiple independent text segments, making prefill a major source of computation. Reusing KV caches is therefore important for reducing serving costs and latency: distributed caching systems spread KV cache across a cluster to increase aggregate capacity, while position-independent caching (PIC) enables reuse of recurring segments under different prefixes. However, existing systems distribute KV caches but still rely on prefix caching (PC), while existing PIC methods enable position-independent reuse without cluster-wide resource management. We present Nebula, the first distributed LLM serving framework to treat PIC segments as first-class citizens, enabling remote PIC reuse and parallel prefill. To track PIC's fine-grained, asynchronous state changes, Nebula combines optimistic accounting with event-driven updates to provide a timely and truthful cluster view for cache management and prefill scheduling. To accommodate diverse reuse patterns across workloads, Nebula leverages cluster-wide ghost-hit feedback to automatically tune the allocation of shared cache capacity between …

item.title: Mosaic:montage-agnostic self-distilled graph learning for subject-independent ieeg seizure detection
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Intracranial EEG provides high signal-to-noise ratio and spatial resolution for detecting epileptic activity, but patient-specific electrode placement leads to substantial variation in channel count and montage across subjects. This heterogeneity limits the generalization of existing detectors under subject-independent evaluation. We propose MOSAIC (MOntage-agnostic Self-distilled Adaptive Inter-channel Connectivity learning), a lightweight graph-learning framework for subject-independent iEEG seizure detection. MOSAIC pairs a shared convolutional channel encoder with a patient-agnostic channel-attention module that infers a weighted inter-channel adjacency matrix from the encoded features, requiring no fixed montage graph. An exponential moving average self-distillation objective regularizes each prediction toward a slowly updated per-patient teacher. Across four public iEEG corpora (SWEC-ETHZ long- and short-term, Mayo, FNUSA), MOSAIC outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in F2 and Cohen's $κ$ while learning more stable inter-channel adjacencies, demonstrating that self-distilled connectivity learning transfers across unseen implantations.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

Intracranial EEG provides high signal-to-noise ratio and spatial resolution for detecting epileptic activity, but patient-specific electrode placement leads to substantial variation in channel count and montage across subjects. This heterogeneity limits the generalization of existing detectors under subject-independent evaluation. We propose MOSAIC (MOntage-agnostic Self-distilled Adaptive Inter-channel Connectivity learning), a lightweight graph-learning framework for subject-independent iEEG seizure detection. MOSAIC pairs a shared convolutional channel encoder with a patient-agnostic channel-attention module that infers a weighted inter-channel adjacency matrix from the encoded features, requiring no fixed montage graph. An exponential moving average self-distillation objective regularizes each prediction toward a slowly updated per-patient teacher. Across four public iEEG corpora (SWEC-ETHZ long- and short-term, Mayo, FNUSA), MOSAIC outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in F2 and Cohen's $κ$ while learning more stable inter-channel adjacencies, demonstrating that self-distilled connectivity learning transfers across unseen implantations.

item.title: More with Less: Efficient Parallel Scientific Code Translation via an Agent-Skill Workflow
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Translating parallel scientific codes between HPC programming frameworks is a critical but labor-intensive task. Existing LLM-based approaches rely on fixed sequential pipelines with undifferentiated repair strategies and correctness criteria that do not match scientific computing practice. We present an agent-skill framework that separates translation, compilation diagnosis, and execution validation into three autonomous agents coordinated by a verdict-driven orchestrator, routing each failure to a targeted repair skill rather than retrying blindly. An automated output check drives the self-correction loop, complemented by an offline LLM-based verification that exposes false positives escaping compiler and runtime checks. We evaluate the framework on 30 HeCBench kernels translated bidirectionally among CUDA, OpenMP, and SYCL with three open-source LLMs. Our framework attains the higher verified correctness rate in all 18 model and direction combinations over a state-of-the-art baseline while consuming up to 52.4% fewer tokens, remaining consistent across models and directions without architectural modification.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Memory as a Temporal Resource: Lifetime Contracts for Multi-Retention Systems
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Computers move and rewrite data whose useful lifetimes range from inner-loop iterations to years, yet memory systems usually hide retention as a fixed physical property. We argue that required lifetime should become a first-class resource across algorithms, programming systems, controllers, and devices. Building on prior lifetime-aware placement, we propose an event-based validity contract that links application completion events to retention-class selection and renewal of protection. Applications would be enabled to express semantic contracts such as ``until this tile completes'' and the system will map data to homogeneous arrays engineered for ephemeral, epoch, or durable retention and preserve correctness through margins, ECC, refresh, migration, or recomputation. We present a trace-based simulator and FPGA prototype that exercises class migration.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: MINE: Entropy-coded Memory-efficient Inference for Large Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：单流 LLM 推理强内存受限（每生成一个 token 每个权重都要从内存流一遍，本地/低延迟部署无法批处理）——无损熵编码能否加速？

方法：MINE：核心是 dtANS-LLM，一个为 LLM 推理改造的 GPU 熵编码方案，利用量化后仍存在的权重非均匀分布；暴露压缩率与解码成本的超参数，按 tensor 与 GPU 自动调参得到模型大小与解码延迟的 Pareto 前沿；以 vLLM 插件集成并按内存预算选择最佳 kernel 配置。

关键数字：Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct + 2.1-bit EntQuant checkpoint 上，相对最快基线 RTX 4060 Ti 加速 2.52×、RTX 5090 加速 1.48×，有效比特率 2.24 与 3.43 bits/weight。

为什么值得看：无损熵编码攻内存瓶颈的新方案，开源且直接集成 vLLM。

item.title: Knowledge Distillation from Neural Networks to Differentiable Logic Networks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Differentiable logic networks (DLNs) are interpretable, edge-friendly classifiers that learn both their logic operators and their connections through gradient descent, achieving accuracy competitive with multi-layer perceptrons at orders-of-magnitude lower inference cost. Their accuracy, however, is bounded by the problems of vanishing gradients, scalability, and lack of an ecosystem, leaving a gap relative to conventional neural networks on several datasets. We introduce knowledge distillation for DLNs to narrow this gap. We distill from a trained multi-layer perceptron teacher into a DLN student, integrating the distillation objective into a two-phase training loop without altering the architecture or the inference procedure. The teacher is discarded after training. Hence, the distilled model retains the interpretability, sparsity, and inference cost of a conventionally trained DLN. We investigate this approach through four variants: a joint hyperparameter search that optimizes the distillation weight and temperature alongside the architecture, a grid search over these two hyperparameters with the architecture fixed, and two single-phase variants that employ distillation during o…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: KnowEvo: Knowledge Evolution for Protein Optimization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in scientific discovery, yet systematically accumulating and refining reusable scientific knowledge remains challenging. Existing approaches primarily improve LLM-based problem solving through parameter optimization or feedback-driven refinement of prompts, programs, and solution trajectories, leaving acquired expertise either embedded in model weights or scattered across iterative problem-solving processes. As a result,knowledge is difficult to systematically inspect, evaluate, and refine. We propose KnowEvo, a framework that treats externalized knowledge itself as the optimization target. Our key insight is that scientific knowledge is inherently modular: multiple interacting mechanisms jointly determine the design outcomes. This makes knowledge evolution fundamentally challenging, as improvements cannot be attributed to individual components in isolation. To address this, KnowEvo represents knowledge as executable expertise blocks and organizes their refinements into strategy mutation trees, enabling structured exploration over a combinatorial knowledge space. item.title: Know What You Need: Efficient Activation Checkpointing
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：大模型训练受内存容量约束，激活检查点通过前向不存激活、反向再物化省内存，但再物化开销大（尤其 Transformer 线性层）——能否用近似计算降本且保持梯度无偏？

方法：利用前向过程收集的信息，只选择性重算最重要的层组件（贪心选择或随机 sketching），得到无偏梯度估计；消融显示所得梯度与精确梯度高度接近。

关键数字：Llama-488M 上仅需重算三分之二的层组件：只作用于 FFN 时 perplexity 增 1.7%，只作用于 attention 时增 1.2%，两者都作用时增 2.5%。

为什么值得看：内存受限大模型训练的新检查点策略，用很小的精度代价换大量重算开销。

item.title: Inside the Trap: A Renewal Law for Prefix-Cache Collapse in LLM Agent Serving
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：前缀缓存让 LLM agent 后续轮次复用 KV，但突发流量可能使引擎陷入"每轮 miss、积压不排空"的陷阱——机理是什么、如何防止？

方法：注册配对实验 + 对陷阱态的理想化精确分析：对每轮都 miss 的流体 FIFO 服务，证明沿 FIFO 轨道各循环满足线性更新递归；并对比两种退出机制（拒绝到达 vs session cap）。

关键数字：两引擎/两 GPU/两模型配对测试（9/10 比率通过），200-session 突发让引擎在 30 次运行中全部零命中到底，无突发对照全部保持良好，session cap 在 30 次封顶运行中全部防住陷阱；理论在未拟合陷阱数据的条件下匹配 57 个卡死运行（50 次平均 served prompt 误差 3% 内）。

为什么值得看：LLM agent serving 前缀缓存崩溃的首次理论刻画与可落地对策（session cap）。

item.title: ISER-MoE: Dynamic In-Switch Replication of Hot Experts for Load Balancing in Expert-Parallel
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：专家并行 MoE 层以最忙 GPU 为步调，少数热专家承担大部分超额负载；复制热专家又受 owner 广播瓶颈制约——如何高效复制？

方法：ISER-MoE（TensorRT-LLM 内实现）：通过 NVLink switch 向固定 GPU 组多播热专家，每个字节只离开 owner 一次；GPU 调度器逐层把热专家分配给组，多端口广播把注入分散到组内端口，并与共享专家重叠执行。

关键数字：trace replay 中调度器消除 98–99% 的超额负载；DeepSeek-V4-Pro prefill 服务中，数学基准吞吐提升 17.4%，agentic prompts 吞吐提升 7.2%。

为什么值得看：MoE 负载均衡的交换机级方案，已在生产推理框架中落地，收益可观。

item.title: Green500: Adventure in Qualifying a Cluster
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Energy effciency has become a key metric for evaluating High Performance Computing (HPC) systems, as reflected by the Green500 ranking. However, energy effciency alone does not capture the full environmental impact of an HPC cluster. Using the Kuma cluster at EPFL, we report on two Green500 measurement campaigns at Level 2 and Level 3, and extend this analysis to a full carbon footprint assessment using the MITSI life-cycle based methodology. GPU power capping experiments show that energy effciency peaks at 450 W, achieving an 11% performance loss offset by a 20% reduction in energy consumption. When embodied emissions are accounted for, the optimal power cap for carbon effciency shifts to 500 W under Switzerland's low-carbon electrical grid, revealing a tension between minimizing usage and embodied contributions. We discuss the challenges of generalizing this approach into a broader carbon-based HPC ranking, and argue that moving beyond energy effciency is both necessary and feasible.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: From LoRA to Language: Recovering Skill Documents from Adapters
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Agent skills are short documents that teach a language model how to handle a class of tasks. To save context, these documents are increasingly compiled into low-rank adapters (LoRA), which keep the behaviour but lose the text: an adapter is hard to read, edit, audit or move to another model. We ask whether the skill document can be written back from the adapter and its frozen base model, and we score each recovered document by the share of the original's key instructions it states and by the tasks it solves. Reading the weights alone recovered little with the methods we tried; a learned map from weights to text passed on about one bit of the document. Running the adapter worked much better. The Executing Writer, a small writer trained on top of the adapted model, recovers 39-44% of the key instructions of held-out skills, against 1.3-1.5% with another skill's adapter, and on adapters fitted to 41 external skills its documents restore 85-91% of the original's task gain. Agent skills are short documents that teach a language model how to handle a class of tasks. To save context, these documents are increasingly compiled into low-rank adapters (LoRA), which keep the behaviour but lose the text: an adapter is hard to read, edit, audit or move to another model. We ask whether the skill document can be written back from the adapter and its frozen base model, and we score each recovered document by the share of the original's key instructions it states and by the tasks it solves. Reading the weights alone recovered little with the methods we tried; a learned map from weights to text passed on about one bit of the document. Running the adapter worked much better. item.title: FondueQA: A Benchmark for Evaluating Parametric Compensation in Multi-Hop QA
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Large Language Models (LLMs) show remarkable performance based on parametric knowledge, i.e., their ability to recall facts and associations internalized in a model's weights. However, studying this capability on established multi-hop benchmarks may be complicated by benchmark contamination, as many of these benchmarks have been publicly available long enough to plausibly appear in modern pretraining corpora. As a result, correct answers under missing evidence may reflect either general parametric knowledge or memorization of benchmark-specific instances. To study how models use internal knowledge when retrieval evidence is incomplete, we introduce FondueQA, in which every required multi-hop fact is uniquely localized to a designated evidence document. This enables controlled document-level evidence ablations to study parametric compensation under incomplete retrieval. Our empirical evaluation reveals that parametric compensation strongly depends on both entity popularity and the structural role of missing evidence. Generally, models compensate more successfully for facts involving popular entities. On FondueQA, we show that bridging evidence can be more useful than the answer-bear…

item.title: Fixed-point acceleration on Neural Wasserstein manifolds
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

We propose a fixed-point acceleration method for optimization over probability measures, applicable to a variety of machine learning problems. We represent probability measures as pushforwards of a reference distribution through a neural network map and equip the parameter space with the induced pullback Wasserstein metric. This geometric structure allows natural gradient descent to be interpreted as a fixed-point iteration on a Riemannian manifold. We accelerate this iteration using Riemannian Anderson mixing method, which exploits historical residuals to capture approximate second-order information without forming Hessians. In the present parametric setting, the manifold is represented by Euclidean coordinates endowed with a point-dependent metric, simplifying retraction and vector transport. We evaluate the method on multimodal sampling, PDE-based inverse problems, aggregation dynamics, Bayesian logistic regression, and generative modeling. Across the tested tasks, Anderson mixing reduces the number of natural-gradient iterations and achieves competitive performance relative to SGD and Adam in terms of both loss-gradient evaluations and wall-clock time. item.title: Fast and Actionable Classification of HPC I/O Time Series
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：HPC 作业共享并行文件系统时 I/O 竞争严重，解决它需要刻画作业的时间 I/O 行为——如何轻量、快速且可行动地分类？

方法：SAGE：把 I/O trace 切成短窗口并学习一个字母表，trace 变成符号序列（"genome"），再用聚类分成类别；两阶段变体 SAGE-2 进一步提速。

关键数字：在 2 个 HPC 系统的 819,771 条真实 trace 上评估；相对最佳基线 K-shape，SAGE-2 中位簇内指标平均降低 9.1%，聚类耗时 2 分钟对比 3.8 小时（109× 加速）；用簇质心指导 I/O 调度，相对 round-robin 的 SOTA 方案 I/O stretch 最多降低 24%。

为什么值得看：HPC I/O 行为分类从"事后分析"变成"可行动调度"，速度快一个数量级以上。

item.title: EventHOI: Event-Driven Resource-Efficient Hand-Object Interaction Logging on Smartglasses
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：智能眼镜连续 RGB 采集与无线传输超出能量与带宽预算——如何低功耗地从第一人称视角记录手-物交互（HOI）？

方法：EventHOI：事件驱动感知与压缩系统，用低功耗事件传感判断何时需要 RGB 采集、以及何处必须保留视觉细节；轻量 IMU 的 egomotion 消除管线抑制自身运动产生的事件，让残余 HOI 运动引导 RGB 触发与空间压缩；构建了智能眼镜原型。

关键数字：50 小时基准（97 名受试者）+ 自行采集的 20 小时真实数据（10 名参与者）；相对 RGB-only 基线，常开后端功耗降低 5.8–10.4×，上行带宽降低 2.9×，HOI 识别精度损失很小；RGB 上行 <130 kbps，适配消费级 BLE 带宽。

为什么值得看：端侧持续感知的能耗-带宽联合优化范式，记忆辅助类眼镜应用的关键使能技术。

item.title: Energy-Based Reasoners: Your Recurrent Reasoner Should Be an Energy-Based Model
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Looping is a powerful inductive bias for reasoning. By repeatedly iterating a recurrent block, looped models can scale their effective depth and enable multi-step reasoning in latent space. However, existing looped models are not inherently guided by an explicit measure of progress, making it difficult to determine when to stop looping and how to improve upon the current state. To enable this, we introduce Energy-Based Reasoners (EBRs), which learn an energy function over latent reasoning states and formulate looped updates as gradient descent on this energy. The energy scores latent states, while its gradient guides refinement and provides a signal for stopping. To train EBRs effectively, we further introduce exploration-based training to discover additional modes and to better shape the energy landscape over a broader set of states. Across four algorithmic reasoning benchmarks, EBRs match or outperform prior recurrent reasoning models, achieving 99.9% accuracy on Sudoku-Extreme while using 345$\times$ less inference compute than the next-best model and maintaining comparable training compute. On all multi-solution benchmarks, EBRs achieve state-of-the-art coverage of distinct val…

item.title: Diversity-Aware Client Selection for Communication-Efficient Federated Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative model training across distributed clients without sharing raw data, making it attractive for privacy-sensitive and bandwidth-constrained applications. A practical challenge in deploying FL is reducing communication overhead while maintaining model performance under heterogeneous, non-IID data distributions. Selecting which subset of clients participates in each training round offers a principled way to address both challenges simultaneously, yet its impact on data diversity and representativeness remains underexplored. In this paper, we investigate three client selection strategies, Power-of-Choice, Fisher information, and Centered Kernel Alignment, evaluating them not only by accuracy and convergence, but through the lens of participation diversity using the Gini coefficient and KL divergence. Under non-IID conditions, restricting participation to 15% of clients per round achieves significant communication savings, and when selection promotes diverse and balanced contributions, it also improves generalization over biased alternatives. item.title: DiffusionRef-IMU: Guide-Anchored Residual Diffusion for Cross-Location Inertial Measurement Unit Translation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Cross-location variation in wearable inertial measurement unit (IMU) signals complicates learning when measurements from a desired target body location are unavailable. This study proposes DiffusionRef-IMU, a two-stage cross-location translation framework in which a deterministic Direct network first estimates the target signal and a guide-anchored residual diffusion model refines only the remaining target discrepancy. The evaluation comprises five subject-disjoint activity-location composition-held-out folds, capacity-matched deterministic and flow-based residual baselines, source-only activity conditioning, computational ablation, and true zero-shot evaluation on two independent datasets. DiffusionRef-IMU with 16-step deterministic DDIM achieved a mean nRMSE of 0.087538 +/- 0.004922, compared with 0.090262 for Direct, 0.088847 for deterministic residual refinement, and 0.088417 for eight-step CompFlow, and outperformed each baseline in all five folds. Four-step DDIM retained a mean nRMSE of 0.087820 at 47.62 ms per window, providing a favourable quality-computation trade-off. item.title: Diffusion-free Score Matching for Exact Conditional Sampling
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

The success of modern score-based generative models is largely driven by diffusion-based training, which learns a collection of time-indexed score fields corresponding to progressively noisier versions of the data distribution. While such models achieve impressive sample quality, leveraging them for sound probabilistic inference---particularly sampling from arbitrary conditionals of the model---remains challenging. This difficulty arises because conditioning information is only available for clean data and not for the higher noise levels required to generate exact conditional samples. In this paper, we introduce DIffusion-free SCOre matching (DISCO), a principled approach that sidesteps the need for time-dependent score fields altogether. Our method is based on an objective that, while reminiscent of diffusion-based training, estimates only a single score of the (slightly perturbed) data distribution, for which the exact conditional score is readily obtained. In experiments, DISCO is competitive with state-of-the-art diffusion models in terms of sample quality. More importantly, DISCO yields a more faithful representation of the underlying data distribution and---crucially---enable…

item.title: DexDICE: Reconciling Safety and Performance via Dual-Expert Offline Imitation Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Ensuring high returns while providing strong safety guarantees in offline imitation learning (IL) is a fundamental challenge: existing approaches either rely on explicitly specified cost functions, which are difficult to design for complex real-world safety constraints, or require expert demonstrations that are both safe and high-performing, which are often too costly to collect. We introduce dual-expert imitation learning, which leverages two complementary data sources: (i) safety-compliant demonstrations that faithfully follow safety guidelines but may be suboptimal, and (ii) performance-oriented demonstrations that achieve high returns but may violate safety guidelines. To address this problem, we propose DexDICE (Dual-expert offline imitation learning via stationary DIstribution Correction Estimation). Instead of conventional distribution constraints, DexDICE combines DICE-style offline learning with safe support constraints, enabling agents to exploit high-return behaviors while remaining within safety-compliant regions. We prove that the ideal solution satisfying this constraint exactly has zero unsafe-region visitation with high probability. We evaluate DexDICE on a re-curat…

item.title: DataHelix: A CPU-GPU Co-Scheduling Data Plane for Multimodal Model Training
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Multimodal model training breaks the loose coupling between data loading and model execution assumed by conventional training pipelines. Large per-sample variation in decoding cost, token/latent count, and tensor size causes both CPU preprocessing time and GPU compute time to vary substantially across data-parallel ranks (training processes). In synchronous training, these two sources of heterogeneity interact tightly: GPU execution determines how long the input pipeline has to prepare the next batch, while delayed preprocessing in any rank in turn stalls all GPUs at synchronization. As a result, optimizing CPU throughput or GPU load balance in isolation cannot eliminate pipeline bubbles. We present DataHelix, a metadata-first CPU-GPU co-scheduling data plane for multimodal training. DataHelix jointly reasons about preprocessing demand and GPU execution progress, treating each GPU compute window as the readiness budget for the next batch and coordinating preprocessing across ranks to minimize deadline misses rather than CPU makespan. item.title: DARIC: A Position-Independent KV Cache Reuse System with Distribution-Aware Recomputation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：agentic 系统与 RAG 中上下文不断变长，位置无关 KV cache 复用依赖重算 token 子集恢复跨块交互，但现有方案 token 选择开销高、质量差且依赖定制执行流——如何系统-算法协同设计？

方法：DARIC：基于经验 KV 偏差分布的自适应 token 选择策略，按偏差模式调度重算；轻量系统架构让独立 KV cache 生成与重算以最小集成开销接入，完整保留推理引擎既有优化。

关键数字：跨多种数据集与 LLM，一致优于 SOTA 方法，TTFT 提速 1.1×–4.5×，生成质量损失可忽略。

为什么值得看：长上下文推理 KV 复用兼顾质量与部署友好，代码已开源（github.com/Lenovo-ICI/DARIC）。

关键数字：跨多种数据集与 LLM，一致优于 SOTA 方法，TTFT 提速 1.1×–4.5×，生成质量损失可忽略。

为什么值得看：长上下文推理 KV 复用兼顾质量与部署友好，代码已开源（github.com/Lenovo-ICI/DARIC）。

item.title: Cross-Layer TopK: Dynamically Allocating Sparsity Across Layers in Transcoders
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Cross-Layer Transcoders (CLTs) decompose the activations of large language models into human-interpretable features and trace how these features interact across layers to form circuits, making them a key tool for mechanistic interpretability. However, training CLTs effectively and efficiently is hard. Beyond the usual trade-off between sparsity and reconstruction quality, a CLT has to model all layers at once, which adds a further challenge. The common JumpReLU recipe controls sparsity only indirectly through a penalty, while the direct extension of TopK selects a fixed number of latents in every layer. Yet reconstruction difficulty differs widely across layers, and intermediate layers are much harder than others, so giving every layer the same budget is suboptimal. We propose Cross-Layer TopK, which sets a single L0 budget for the whole model and dynamically allocates it across layers during training. In a comparison with JumpReLU and other TopK variants on Qwen3-8B-Base, this gives lower FVU while using 20% fewer active latents than JumpReLU. The better reconstruction carries over to circuit tracing, yielding more complete circuits with higher replacement and completeness scores.…

item.title: Copies Are Not Confirmations: How News Duplication Fools LLM Judges and Continual Learners
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Many news reports of a claim are copies of one source: wire stories, content shared within a media group, syndicated features and press releases. We ask whether LLM judges and continual learners treat such copies as independent confirmations. In 200,000 English CC-News articles, a MinHash detector links 18.9% to a near-copy from another outlet (precision 0.97 once boilerplate is removed); it links 92% of edited reprints to their originals but none of the LLM rewrites by phi4, Llama 3.2 or Gemini 2.5 Flash. Shown three identical reprints of a claim about an unknown person instead of one report, Llama 3.2 3B and phi4 14B raised the share of lies they accepted from 0.06 to 0.71 and from 0.21 to 0.90 and ignored a note that the reports came from one source; Gemini 2.5 Flash already believed a single report, and Gemini 2.5 Pro followed provenance notes and tables. In a simulated continual-learning stream, showing the judge one report per detected chain cut the copied lies it accepted by 0.10-0.24 across four judges, at a mean cost of no more than 4.2 percentage points of accepted truths. item.title: Controllable Molecule Generation via Sparse Representation Editing: An Interpretability-Driven Perspective
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Controllable molecule generation is crucial for diverse scientific applications, such as drug discovery and materials design. While large language models (LLMs) show great promise, their dense and entangled representations impede precise control over the generation of molecules with bespoke substructures or properties. To address this, we propose Sparse Representation Editing (SpaRE), an interpretability-driven framework for fine-grained and precise control in LLM-based molecule generation. The crux of SpaRE is to learn an overcomplete sparse feature space that disentangles LLM representations into a compact set of latent features corresponding to chemically meaningful concepts. Within this space, we can directly manipulate these concept-aligned latent features to achieve (1) local control, by generating target atoms and functional groups at specified positions; and (2) global control, by customizing the overall structural and physicochemical properties within defined ranges. In this way, our framework advances interpretability from post-hoc analysis to actionable generative control. Experiments show that SpaRE can generate chemically desirable molecules under complex constraints i…

item.title: Consensus-Constrained Dual-Federated Optimization with Client-Side Dynamic Weighting for Distributed Android Device Threat Defense
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Smartphones, smart-home hubs, and wearables are increasingly exposed to sophisticated Android malware, while centralized threat-detection pipelines raise privacy and scalability concerns. Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative model training without collecting raw client data, but partial participation and variation in local model quality can destabilize global optimization. In this article, we propose DW-FedADMM, a federated optimization framework that combines primal-dual coordination with performance-dependent client-side weighting. The dynamic coefficient modulates each participating client's local state before the augmented-Lagrangian update, while the dual variables regulate disagreement between local and global model states. We evaluate DW-FedADMM on three Android malware benchmarks, namely Drebin, Malgenome, and TUANDROMD, with 5, 10, and 15 clients holding IID data shards, partial client participation, and communication budgets of 5 and 10 rounds. Each configuration is repeated with ten random seeds. DW-FedADMM obtains the highest seed-averaged accuracy on Drebin (97.64% +/- 0.20%) and the best mean accuracy in 9 of the 18 dataset-client-round configurations, includ…

item.title: Concurrent Use of FP32 and FP64 Computing Units on GPUs and Mixed-Precision Placement in WENO Reconstruction
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Scientific computing often requires FP64 arithmetic, although FP64 performance is limited on NVIDIA GPUs. Double-float (DF) emulation, which represents a value using two FP32 values with about 48 bits of significand, outperforms native FP64 where FP64 units are limited. On the other hand, mixed-precision strategies offload to FP32 the operations that do not determine accuracy. In both approaches, the native FP64 units remain idle during FP32 instruction execution. We investigated whether this idle resource can be recovered on A100, GH200, GB200, and RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q. A microbenchmark shows that co-resident FP32 and native-FP64 kernels exceed the throughput of the faster kernel alone on A100 but not on GH200 and GB200; on RTX 6000 Blackwell, they do so against FFMA but, against DF emulation, only when the issue density of the DF kernel is reduced. We then tested whether this gain carries over to computing the WENO-Z reconstruction with the nonlinear weights in FP32 and the candidate polynomials in native FP64 (W32P64). We observe substantial overlap on A100, whereas GH200, GB200, and RTX 6000 Blackwell show little overlap. Importantly, the fastest placement does not alwa…

item.title: Composable Causality: A Toolkit for Systematic Time-Series Causal Discovery and Treatment-Effect Benchmarking
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Real-world multivariate time series rarely come with verified ground-truth causal structure, so research on time-series causal discovery and treatment-effect estimation depends on synthetic data. Existing tools are either fixed datasets that cannot be modified after release or script-based generators in which each script fixes one combination of mechanism, confounding, and missingness. Neither supports controlled experiments that vary a single property, such as sparsity, noise distribution, or missingness mechanism, while holding the others fixed. Counterfactual evaluation has the same gap, since existing simulators are built per paper with hardcoded mechanisms or produce observational data only. We introduce DTCD (Datasets and Toolkit for Causal Discovery), a data generation library that produces multivariate time series with ground-truth contemporaneous and lagged adjacency matrices. Topology, mechanism, noise, observational mask, and intervention policy are independent components that compose through configuration alone. Paired counterfactual twins, produced by caching the stochastic realization during the factual rollout and re-injecting it during the interventional rollout, re…

item.title: Capital Efficiency, Isolation, Risk, and Ruin in Generative AI Inference Serving Infrastructure
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Generative AI serving is an extremely capital-intensive endeavor that demands rapid, step-change improvements in capital efficiency to prevent industry wide increases in the cost of capital from limiting growth plans. Keeping pace with the economic necessities will increasingly require infrastructure providers to confront operationally-inconvenient realities of production serving, including the extreme heterogeneity of generative AI request costs. We have explored workload isolation as a foundational, fleet-level lever for increasing capital efficiency. Isolation is the practice of intelligently grouping "like" requests before execution. Rather than exposing every replica to the full heterogeneous workload distribution, isolation deliberately reshapes the workload presented to the hardware by assigning requests with different cost characteristics to different portions of the fleet. Workload isolation on its own does not make expensive requests cheaper; it prevents a costly portion of the workload from unnecessarily determining the operating point and capital efficiency of the entire fleet. It additionally lays the foundational groundwork that can serve as a launching point for comp…

item.title: BiLoGo: Reducing the smoothing of localised responses in Transformer-based neural operators for sheet forming
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Trial-and-error FE simulation of sheet forming could be computationally expensive, neural-network-based learned simulators are used to accelerate design. These simulators should accurately capture localised responses, such as thinning around sharp radii or near ribs, which determine formability. Transformer-based neural operators propagate information efficiently across the mesh but tend to smooth such localised responses. This study develops BiLoGo, a Bipartite Local-Global learned simulator with an FE-guided design that connects local node-element message passing with a Transformer-based neural operator for long-range information exchange. BiLoGo has three modules: a bidirectional node-element GraphSAGE model that learns nodal-elemental coupling on a bipartite graph and predicts each quantity on its native FE entity without interpolation; a dual-stream Transformer-based neural operator that processes blank deformation and tool contact with separate token sets, preventing localised contact information from being averaged with the whole-blank state; and a fusion and element update module that combines global and local features via gated residual fusion and updates element features …

item.title: Adaptive Scheduling Pipeline for Multi-Instance Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

We present the Adaptive Scheduling Pipeline (ASP), an offline rollout scheduler for multi-instance asynchronous reinforcement learning (RL) of large language models (LLMs). ASP jointly reduces three sources of rollout underutilization - padding bubbles from intra-minibatch length heterogeneity, skewness bubbles from long-tail outputs, and sorting bubbles from fluctuations in training-queue occupancy induced by length-sorted dispatch - through a single offline preprocessing pass. This enables efficient multi-instance rollout that overcomes the early scaling plateau of single-instance inference while smoothing the arrival of generated samples at the trainer. We integrate the scheduler into an asynchronous architecture that decouples rollout from training while keeping policy lag observable and bounded. Complete ASP improves end-to-end throughput by up to 3.22 times and reduces iteration time by up to 76.8% relative to MindSpeed-RL, while reducing iteration time by up to 62.5% relative to verl. Within ASP, scheduling reduces mean iteration time by 10.9%. ASP also scales more robustly with additional generation resources than these baselines and shows no visible convergence degradation…

item.title: Accelerating Reinforcement Learning Weight Refit with the Reshard Collective
item.description:
发表方：NVIDIA Technical Blog　发布：2026-11-06　分类：技术博客 / 每日精选

核心话题：RL 后训练中训练与推理 GPU 分离部署，需周期性把最新权重从训练端刷新到推理端（refit）；现有 gather-and-broadcast 方式通信量约为模型权重的两倍，随模型规模急剧膨胀。

要点：NCCL M2N Reshard——专为加速 RL 权重 refit 设计的新型集合通信原语：把 refit 重构为 DTensor-to-DTensor 传输问题，避免"先重建完整张量再广播"的中间表示，消除 gather 与 broadcast 两阶段的冗余通信；参考实现已在 NVIDIA/nccl-extensions 开源。

关键数字：Kimi K3 含 2.8 万亿参数、Qwen 3.8 2.4T A95B 含 2.4 万亿参数，BF16（每参数 2 字节）下权重约 5.6 TB 与 4.8 TB；gather+broadcast 两段合计逻辑载荷约模型权重两倍，当前最大开源模型单次 refit 通信已约 10 TB。

为什么值得看：RL 训练规模化中权重同步瓶颈的系统级解法，训练框架团队可直接采用。

item.title: xDSL-CCPP: An alternative code generator for atmospheric modelling
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF

The Common Community Physics Package (CCPP) is a framework designed to simplify the exchange of physics packages between state-of-the-art atmospheric models. A core software component of CCPP is a code generator: a bespoke Python-based application th…

The Common Community Physics Package (CCPP) is a framework designed to simplify the exchange of physics packages between state-of-the-art atmospheric models. A core software component of CCPP is a code generator: a bespoke Python-based application that uses regular expressions to transform an input specification into Fortran source code. While the code generator initially provided a simple transformation capability, the demands of state-of-the-art atmospheric models have resulted in significant increases in its complexity. Furthermore, ongoing code modernisation efforts to enable GPU-based computing have placed additional demands on the code generator for which it was never designed. Domain Specific Languages (DSLs) have proven to be highly effective in High Performance Computing (HPC), offering the ability to simplify code modernisation efforts. However, traditionally the effort and specialist skills required in the development of a DSL have been a blocker to adoption. In recent years, however, there have been great advances in compiler technologies, and frameworks such as MLIR and xDSL have the potential to greatly lower this barrier to entry. In this paper, we present xDSL-CCPP,…

item.title: TopoSHAP: Shapley for Explainable and Efficient Topological Deep Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF

Topological deep learning (TDL) extends learning on graphs, such as molecules or social networks, to higher-order structures, such as rings in a molecule or groups in a social network. Explaining which of these structures drive a model's predictions, and which architectural components matter most for its performance, remains challenging. We introduce TopoSHAP, an efficient and general explanation framework that addresses both questions across topological domains and model architectures. TopoSHAP-cell assigns Shapley values to topological data cells and extracts compact explanations. These explanations match or outperform graph-based counterparts on GraphXAI benchmark data while running up to 112$\times$ faster. They also reveal advantageous topological feature design, leading to measured improvements in explanation recovery and predictive accuracy. On the architecture side, TopoSHAP-neighbor explains how neighborhoods contribute to model performance, and turns these evaluations into a backward-elimination search that identifies smaller, competitive architectures early in training. This is up to $11.3\times$ cheaper than traditional TDL training sweeps.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: The GPU Needs an Operating System
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：AI 芯片服务模型时大量空闲——回复必须快、每步都在等内存，数学单元利用率极低——GPU 是否需要操作系统？

方法：论证 GPU 需要一个 OS：调度紧急工作、用其他有用工作填满空闲算力；给出已发布特性与更激进的研究系统方案，并说明扩展到多模型所需的编译器与新芯片特性。

关键数字：两个大型开放模型上数学单元仅忙碌约 6–11%；已发布特性以共享设计的工作可回收 1/4 GPU、真实任务回收 1/10，decode 仅慢 5%；研究系统中单个常驻 kernel 跑完整模型快于 vLLM 单请求最优，共享 GPU 时减速低于 2%。

为什么值得看：从利用率视角重构 GPU 软件栈的纲领性观点，推理系统设计值得参考。

item.title: Should You Split Decode? Disaggregation Across Future Models and Accelerators
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：prefill/decode 分离（P/D）之外，把 decode 再拆成 attention/FFN 分离（AFD）增加了通信与部署约束——未来模型与加速器路线下还值不值？

方法：提出 SiliconForge 校准模型，独立变化服务分解与硬件分配；在四个模型方向、四类加速器、两种互连上对比 P/D 与 P/D+AFD，用相同流水线重叠规则与功耗预算联合优化。

关键数字：主对比显示 AFD 在 SLO goodput/kW 上无稳健的部署级优势；最大 AFD 领先来自多容纳一个 prefill 副本而非更高效的 decode 池；KV-heavy 方向在专家池横跨多个小型 scale-up 域时 AFD 名义领先。

为什么值得看：用可复现的校准模型回答「是否拆分 decode」的基础设施决策，前瞻性规划直接可用。

原文：Should You Split Decode? Disaggregation Across Future Models and Accelerators

item.title: Scaling Up Analog CIM: A Simulation Framework for Topology-Aware Mapping
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：模拟 CIM 扩展到更多芯片（chiplet）时，基于局部算子成本与聚合通信的抽象掩盖了权重映射拓扑的影响——如何量化并利用这一设计维度？

方法：开发相位分析量化映射拓扑对系统性能的影响强度与映射优化可转化的延迟收益；提出 Isobar 仿真平台，集成 CIM 分解、异构执行与资源建模，经硅片实测与周期精确仿真验证。

关键数字：Gemma-7B prefill 上 Isobar 引导映射比最强基线降低通信时间 23.3%、端到端延迟 18.6%；系统级建模显示扩展到数千 die 时模拟 CIM 仍保持相对 GPU 的能效优势。

为什么值得看：首个把拓扑感知映射做成可搜索设计维度的模拟 CIM 平台，大模型部署选型有据可依。

原文：Scaling Up Analog CIM: A Simulation Framework for Topology-Aware Mapping

item.title: SAFTAC: Simulation-Augmented Fine-Tuning of Open-Source LLMs for Analog Circuit Design
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF

Circuit design for analog integrated circuits (ICs) is challenging because circuit topology, device sizing, and circuit performance are tightly coupled. Existing large language model (LLM)-based methods either rely on inference-time correction around frozen models or train on limited circuit types without directly using simulation outcomes as training signals. A key bottleneck is that existing datasets do not provide sufficient task information for training LLMs on end-to-end specification-conditioned design. To fill this gap, we first construct a large-scale simulation-grounded dataset with 8,626 design tasks across 10 different types of analog circuits, where each task includes a textual description, labeled I/O ports, loading condition, target specifications, a testbench, and a reference netlist. Using this dataset, we present SAFTAC, a simulation-augmented fine-tuning framework that trains LLMs to generate and revise analog circuit design. SAFTAC combines three-stage supervised fine-tuning, which progressively builds the capabilities required for analog circuit design and feedback-guided correction, with simulation feedback-augmented reinforcement fine-tuning, which further opt…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Rule-Guided and Trajectory-Aware Repair for LLM-Based HLS Generation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：LLM 直接生成可综合 HLS-C 时，多轮工具反馈与可复用 HLS 知识难以转成有效修订——如何提升端到端生成成功率？

方法：提出 MementoHLS，可执行可证伪的双记忆引导修复框架：ERCL 把跨任务 HLS 知识转为证据门控修复动作，RFL 把任务内修复历史转为轨迹证据抑制无效路径；Same-Candidate Reviewer 把解析/编译/测试台/综合结果绑定到对应候选，Single-Commit Arbiter 每轮最多提交一个候选。

关键数字：94 个 HLS-Eval 与 170 个 Bench4HLS 任务上，TB∧Synth pass@1/pass@5 从 41.7%/57.4% 提升至 58.9%/68.1%（HLS-Eval），从 15.5%/32.9% 提升至 32.4%/50.6%（Bench4HLS）。

为什么值得看：HLS 生成端到端可靠性提升显著，证据绑定机制避免错误归因，工程价值直接。

原文：Rule-Guided and Trajectory-Aware Repair for LLM-Based HLS Generation

item.title: ResServe: Accurate and Efficient FP4 LLM Inference with Residue Compensation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：FP4 量化降低 LLM 推理成本但损害任务质量，提高精度计算又吃掉效率收益——能否利用解码阶段空闲算力低成本恢复精度？

方法：ResServe 在 FP4 激活基座之上叠加 FP4 量化的残差（表示量化丢失的信息），利用解码常见窄矩阵计算留下的空闲硬件容量计算残差贡献，片内合并结果、避免额外传输；对线性层与 decode attention 应用，输入 prompt 处理用选择性补偿控制额外开销。

关键数字：NVIDIA B200 上，补偿后的 NVFP4 线性核在少行操作下保持接近未补偿执行的延迟；相对 W4A4 请求延迟最多增加 3.4%，相对 W4A8 请求延迟降低 22.4–53.3%；五个模型上代码生成准确率相对同格式未补偿推理平均提升 15.04%（NVFP4）与 53.57%（MXFP4）。

为什么值得看：FP4 推理"精度-效率"两全的新机制，量化推理部署可直接采用。

item.title: ReKV: Overlapping Quantized KV Transfer and Suffix Recomputation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：prefill-decode 分离中 KV cache 在 worker 间传递是首 token 前的关键延迟——只压缩或只重算都不够，能否在传输的同时重建后缀？

方法：ReKV 传输量化前缀 KV cache 加一个 BF16 边界状态，前缀在途时在 decode worker 上重建连续后缀；传输层数与精度、重算层数可联合选择。

关键数字：跨节点 H100 合成基准中，满足质量标准的 Q8 配置将 8K handoff 延迟相对 BF16 传输降低 2.36×（Qwen2.5-7B）、2.84×（Qwen2.5-3B）、3.65×（Qwen3-8B），并快于最优的纯传输或纯重算；真实权重 BF16 重算实验将 prefill-to-token-return 时间降低 1.16–1.63×。

为什么值得看：把压缩与重算结合并重叠执行，优于任一单独手段，分布式 LLM 推理直接受益。

item.title: Quantum Advantage in Local Certification of Graph Properties
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF

Local certification allows network vertices to verify global properties using certificates from an untrusted prover and communication with their neighbors. Its complexity is the maximum certificate size at any vertex. Fraigniaud et al. (ITCS 2021) in…

Local certification allows network vertices to verify global properties using certificates from an untrusted prover and communication with their neighbors. Its complexity is the maximum certificate size at any vertex. Fraigniaud et al. (ITCS 2021) introduced the distributed quantum Merlin-Arthur (dQMA) model and proved an exponential quantum advantage for distributed equality, measured in input-string length. We resolve a question of Hasegawa, Kundu, and Nishimura (PODC 2024) by establishing unconditional exponential and polynomial quantum advantages for graph properties, which depend only on network topology, with complexity measured in the number $n$ of vertices. For every fixed integer $μ\ge 1$, we construct a graph property admitting a one-round dQMA protocol with $O(μ\log n)$-qubit certificates and messages, whereas every $μ$-round distributed Merlin-Arthur (dMA) protocol requires $Ω(n/(μ\log^2 n))$-bit certificates. We also give a one-round dQMA protocol for graph symmetry, the existence of a nontrivial automorphism, with $\widetilde{O}(n^{5/3})$-qubit certificates. This yields a polynomial advantage over one-round dMA protocols, for which an $Ω(n^2)$-bit certificate lower bo…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Precision - Preserving Subtensor Inference for a 22B Joint Audio - Video Generator under a Fixed GPU Working Set
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：整块 offloading 需要每个传输块塞进 GPU 预算，大模型在固定显存下如何保持精度地推理？

方法：提出 PSI（Precision-Preserving Subtensor Inference），固定 arena 运行时：子块权重流式传输 + 中间状态独立管理，针对 BF16 LTX-2.5 22B 音视频联合 transformer；分区算子保持稠密实算术构造，并分离资源占用、传输正确性与数值保真控制。

关键数字：RTX A6000 九个匹配 prompt 下峰值内存从 8,578 降至 360 MiB；十一次 transformer 调用平均耗时 247.11→349.00 s；托管 arena 仅 80 MiB；3 GiB 显存上限下原生生成与 FLASH 路径均成功；FFN 复用降低平均块耗时 4.0%。

为什么值得看：把大模型 offload 推理压到固定 3 GiB 显存仍保精度，边缘与受限环境直接受益。

原文：Precision - Preserving Subtensor Inference for a 22B Joint Audio - Video Generator under a Fixed GPU Working Set

item.title: Post-Quantum Authentication of IoT Data on Ethereum: Signatures, the Calldata Floor, and Device-Signed Merkle Roots
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF

Field devices deployed today will still be producing records when quantum computers may break their signatures, so systems that anchor IoT data on blockchains need a post-quantum (PQ) authentication path now. We measure its cost on Ethereum under the…

Field devices deployed today will still be producing records when quantum computers may break their signatures, so systems that anchor IoT data on blockchains need a post-quantum (PQ) authentication path now. We measure its cost on Ethereum under the current execution rules, including the EIP-7623 calldata floor and the EIP-7825 transaction cap, and under the calldata repricing scheduled for the Glamsterdam upgrade. We combine device-side measurements of ML-DSA, Falcon, SLH-DSA, LMS and XMSS, reproduced costs of open-source Solidity verifiers, a new standard-compliant LMS/HSS verifier for SHA-256 and SHA-256/192, and complete transactions on an Osaka-rule EVM, priced with today's verifiers and with proposed precompiles. Three results stand out. Signing every record costs 8.7 times as much as ECDSA even with an ML-DSA precompile, because the calldata floor rather than verification sets the price. When each device signs a Merkle root over 100 records, a standard LMS verifier available today costs about 3,350 gas per record, against 245 gas for ECDSA in the same design, and it is unaffected by the scheduled repricing, which raises floor-bound designs by up to 1.9 times. item.title: Patching the Blind Spots: Reversible LLM Rule Overlay for Frozen Fraud Detectors
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF

In industrial tabular fraud classification, gradient-boosted trees remain state-of-the-art, but even a well-trained model has blind spots, and retraining the deployed model is not always safe. We propose a framework that patches such a model without modifying it: LLMs propose rules anchored on features the model underweights by SHAP, and the resulting noisy pool is screened for empirical support and calibrated into an additive, reversible log-lift overlay that runs at the production cut-off. Single-LLM benefit is high-variance and inverts between datasets, so we pool three diverse backbones by equal-weight logit averaging, trading peak gain for a bounded worst case. On a real-world e-commerce fraud detector trained on selection-biased data, continued training regresses even when carefully tuned, whereas the overlay gains on average +2.26% recall at equal precision ($Δ$R@P) and +1.60% precision at equal recall ($Δ$P@R) over production cut-offs spanning 30-57% precision and 23-63% recall. On a public benchmark of seven designed bias-shift variants it raises $Δ$P@R on every variant and keeps $Δ$R@P near neutral. Each amendment is a readable predicate naming the fraud pattern it covers…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: OpenRDMA: A GPU-Native Multi-Path Reliable RDMA Transport Architecture
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：大集群算力密度上升，网络通信越来越限制系统性能；GPU 发起通信要低开销提交，但 GDR 控制面仍依赖 CPU、IBGDA 要 GPU 组装 WQE 消耗 SM 与带宽——怎么办？

方法：OpenRDMA 开源多路径可靠 RDMA 传输架构：最小 GPU doorbell（GPU 发 8 字节 token，FPGA NIC 从预配置上下文重建完整 WQE）；基于 MRC 支持逐包多路径与乱序到达，选择性重传、有序 DMA 放置与 GPU 可见标志轮询保证可靠交付；硬件-软件协同重传，NIC 管快速数据传输、CPU 管超时检测与恢复策略。

关键数字：正文给出架构与关键硬件组件描述，FPGA 原型实现进行中，尚无实测性能数字。

为什么值得看：把 WQE 装配移出 GPU、控制面留在 CPU，是 GPU 原生通信路径的务实新架构，开源可跟进。

原文：OpenRDMA: A GPU-Native Multi-Path Reliable RDMA Transport Architecture

item.title: On the Few-Shot Adaptation of Vision-Language Models: A Few Gradient Signs Are All You Need
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF

The limited supervision available for the few-shot adaptation of vision-language models makes gradient estimation particularly noisy. We find that the gradient magnitudes are severely miscalibrated, while the signs of a small top-magnitude subset remain informative. This motivates SignSparseSGD and DynSignSparseSGD, two state-free optimizers that use gradient magnitudes only to select where to update and fixed-magnitude signs to decide how to update. The static variant fixes the support after the first minibatch. The dynamic variant refreshes it at every step. Across 11 datasets, three CLIP backbones, and five shot levels, the proposed methods are competitive with or outperform parameter-efficient and optimization-based baselines on average, while exhibiting markedly lower sensitivity to long training schedules. They introduce no task-specific modules, maintain no first- or second-moment optimizer states, and use one shared configuration across datasets, backbones, and shot levels. Our code is included in the supplementary materials and will be released upon publication.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Not All Misalignment Is Alike: A Decomposed Benchmark for Emergent Misalignment
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF

Emergent misalignment (EM), in which fine-tuning on a narrow task induces misaligned behaviour on unrelated prompts, has been demonstrated across a wide range of datasets, model families, and training setups. Yet, most studies continue to rely on the evaluation approach introduced in the original EM paper, producing rates that are sensitive to the small set of evaluation questions used, the choice of judge, and the thresholds applied. These evaluations can also conflate misalignment with capability loss and offer little insight into the specific ways misalignment manifests. Differences in datasets, models, and fine-tuning configurations further make findings difficult to compare across studies. We introduce EMERGE, a decomposed benchmark that tracks changes in eight distinct misaligned behaviours from base to fine-tuned models. It evaluates these behaviours on out-of-domain prompts against matched benign controls and tracks capability, coherence, and refusal to account for potential confounders. Applying EMERGE to 8 open-weight models and 13 fine-tuning datasets, we find that models with similar broad misalignment rates can exhibit very different behavioural profiles that a single …

item.title: MotionBench-XAI: Benchmarking What Shapes Shapley Explanations in Spatiotemporal Machine Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF

Predicting outcomes from spatiotemporal data, such as assessing Parkinson's severity from human motion, often requires explainability in addition to accuracy. Practitioners need to know what drove the prediction, whether it be spatial (a body joint), temporal (a specific window), or both. Shapley values are attributions computed by treating input features as players in a cooperative game and measuring how the model output changes as coalitions of players are removed. Computing them involves choosing what counts as players, how absent players are imputed, and how the game is evaluated. How these choices affect explanation quality is poorly understood for spatiotemporal data, and real data carries no ground-truth attributions to check against. We present MotionBench-XAI, a benchmark built on i) five synthetic spatiotemporal datasets with exact ground-truth Shapley values, ii) three real datasets across clinical gait, electrocardiogram, and audio, iii) ten attribution methods across three player sets, and iv) three trained architectures. We show that grouping features into players, across time, space, or both, matters more than the choice of imputer. Generative imputers improve explan…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: More Performance From Every Byte: How Full-Stack Codesign Solves AI's Memory Challenge
item.description:
发表方：NVIDIA Blog　发布：2026-11-05　分类：技术博客 / 每日精选

核心话题 大模型、长上下文与 agentic 应用推高 GPU 显存压力，NVIDIA 主张以全栈协同设计（full-stack codesign）而非单纯堆 HBM 来应对。

要点 GPU HBM 是最快也最贵的一层，模型权重与 KV cache 竞争有限容量；下方 CPU 内存、本地 SSD、共享存储按更低每比特成本逐层扩展。做法是压缩须存内容、放到合适层级、并在 GPU 需要前取回；agentic 推理轨迹单请求上下文可达 300 万 token，加剧 KV cache 膨胀；更大 HBM 只有带宽搬得动才有用。

关键数字 从 Blackwell Ultra 到 Vera Rubin 平台，单 GPU HBM 容量约增 3%，而 agentic 每美元吞吐最高提升 30 倍（SemiAnalysis AgentX 口径）。

为什么值得看 解释"显存不够"为什么不是简单加 HBM 的问题，给出 AI 工厂内存/存储层级设计的第一手工程视角。

item.title: Modular Parameterized Model Checking of Threshold-Based Distributed Algorithms
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF

We present a novel approach for model checking fault-tolerant distributed algorithms: instead of building large, monolithic algorithm models, we propose a modular approach where the user decomposes the algorithm into modules, verifies them individual…

We present a novel approach for model checking fault-tolerant distributed algorithms: instead of building large, monolithic algorithm models, we propose a modular approach where the user decomposes the algorithm into modules, verifies them individually, and replaces them with a synchronous abstraction. To enable our technique, we introduce a new system model that combines aspects of threshold automata and global synchronization protocols. We investigate the expressiveness of our new model, and present a (bounded) model checking procedure as well as a method for checking the correctness of the abstraction step. We implemented the technique and report on promising experimental results on a case study

item.title: Minimum-Sufficient Knowledge and Computation for Wind Energy Predictive Analysis
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF

Resource-constrained cyber-physical decision systems often apply fixed sensing, knowledge, and computational pipelines despite state-dependent information needs. We introduce Minimum-Sufficient Knowledge and Computation (MSKC), a resource-aware computing principle: select the least-costly route meeting decision-risk and deployment constraints, escalating only when cheaper routes are insufficient. As proof of concept, we isolate adaptive knowledge routing, the decision underlying Knowledge-Guided Machine Learning (KGML), which conventionally injects external knowledge unconditionally rather than only where needed. We instantiate this for wind ramp-event predictive analysis, an edge-oriented decision-support task, evaluating local, relational, and physics-informed routes with a state-aware gate on publicly available real data from two wind farms. We establish conditions for feasibility preservation, cost dominance, and strict expected savings over always-on routing. At a 35.9% relational-knowledge injection rate, adaptive routing is statistically indistinguishable from always-on injection on the reported metrics while reducing knowledge calls by 64%, supporting sustainable, Green-IT-…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。
