为什么值得看：把 RL 训练两阶段的硬件需求差异变成可在线利用的节能空间，是面向推理/训练一体节能调度的实用方案。

原文：Energy-Efficient Reinforcement Learning for Large Language Models

item.title: Empirical Bayes Flow Matching for Continuous Cryo-EM Heterogeneity
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

经验贝叶斯流匹配：连续 cryo-EM 异质性的生成先验学习

We address the problem of learning generative priors over high-dimensional latent variables from indirect, noisy observations, with a focus on continuous heterogeneity in cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM). In this setting, 3D atomic structures $x \in \mathbb{R}^{3N_a}$ are never directly observed and must be inferred from 2D projection images $y$ generated by a complex, non-linear forward operator. We propose Empirical Bayes Flow Matching (EB-FM), a method that learns a flow matching prior $p_θ(x)$ directly from observations using a Monte Carlo stochastic approximation Expectation-Maximization framework. EB-FM alternates between an E-step that performs approximate posterior sampling from $p_θ(x \mid y)$ via guided flow-based generation while maintaining persistent latent estimates through stochastic approximation, and an M-step that updates the flow model using these stabilized latent variables as training targets. This approach eliminates the need for pretraining on clean data and naturally accommodates non-linear forward models. We validate our method on controlled inverse problems using two-moons and MNIST data, and demonstrate its effectiveness on simulated cryo-EM data with k…

item.title: Easy Multi-Precision Acceleration via Vectorization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.PF　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：高层编程语言 + 加速器支持多样数值精度与更高带宽，但能否只靠简单向量化编码就拿到接近硬件峰值的性能，跨精度、跨硬件世代保持可移植？

方法：用把运算表达为高层矩阵数学的向量化编码技术，对带宽、实数/复数矩阵乘与 2D 卷积等示例程序，在跨度近十年的多代硬件上系统评测各精度下的性能可达性。

关键数字：在内存带宽、双/单/半精度实复矩阵乘、FFT 2D 卷积上均接近硬件峰值；还发现以计算强度换内存强度的算法有显著潜力。

为什么值得看：证明「高生产力 ≠ 低性能」——简单向量化就能从高层语言环境触达近峰值性能，对性能可移植编程有直接指导意义。

item.title: Dual-VaDE: Efficient and Robust Prototype Learning via Variational Dual-Domain Mixture Priors
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

Dual-VaDE：变分双域混合先验的高效鲁棒原型学习

In this paper, we propose Dual-VaDE, an unsupervised generative framework for learning interpretable anatomical prototypes from unlabeled medical images. In contrast to previous variational methods that rely on a single spatial latent code, which often entangles global geometry with local textures and fails to capture their cross-domain dependencies, Dual-VaDE introduces a dual-domain Gaussian mixture prior that explicitly couples spatial anatomy with phase-preserving Fourier spectral representations. We derive an exact, closed-form variational lower bound that fuses this joint prior into the decoder and optimizes the entire network end-to-end via an alternating EM formulation, avoiding heuristic two-stage clustering while ensuring superior training stability and robustness. Evaluated on OASIS-3 brain MRI, Dual-VaDE delivers substantially sharper and more plausible prototypes, achieves superior cluster separation with improvements of up to 94% over spatial-only baselines, exhibits markedly reduced variance across random seeds, and incurs negligible inference overhead (0.28 ms per image).

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.DC)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

MEC 数字孪生网络中新鲜度感知预处理的分布式线性 bandit

Digital twins (DTs) require timely updates from Internet of Things (IoT) devices to accurately represent the state of the corresponding physical systems, but transmitting large data volumes can compromise freshness. Moreover, different task classes have distinct computational demands and freshness requirements, while stochastic task generation and sizes complicate resource allocation. In this paper, we propose a freshness-aware framework in which multi-access edge computing (MEC) servers preprocess IoT data, reducing transmission volume and DT-server processing load. The framework establishes mutual support between DT and MEC servers. The DTs determine feasible CPU-allocation strategies guaranteeing class-specific age-of-information (AoI) requirements under specified workload, delay, and update-generation bounds. MEC servers collaboratively identify the feasible strategy minimizing expected freshness-normalized preprocessing delay. item.title: Distributed LTL Synthesis under Arbitrary Message Adversaries
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.DC)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

任意消息对手下的分布式 LTL 综合：两进程不可靠链路轮通信下综合不可判定性的理论结果

Reactive synthesis is the problem of generating a program that produces outputs satisfying a logical specification for every input stream. We study distributed synthesis for two processes communicating in rounds over unreliable links, with at least one message delivered in every round. Despite this delivery guarantee, we show that synthesis from linear temporal logic specifications is undecidable, even when messages carry the processes' complete causal histories. More generally, we give a complete characterization of the communication restrictions that make synthesis decidable. Restrictions are described by a message adversary $A$, a set of allowed infinite graph histories: sequences of communication graphs, each specifying which messages are delivered in a round. Iterated chromatic subdivision associates these histories with points in the unit interval, yielding an image $π(A) \subseteq [0,1]$. For every $ω$-regular message adversary $A$, synthesis is decidable if and only if $π(A)$ is nowhere dense. In the decidable cases, our procedure takes a deterministic parity automaton for $A$ and a specification, decides realizability, and constructs a realizing distributed algorithm whene…

item.title: Deep Learning Compilers: Architecture, Optimization, and Empirical Characterization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 深度学习模型日益复杂、硬件愈发异构，DL 编译器如何架构、各优化手段实际效果如何？现有工作缺乏系统性的架构梳理与定量实证。

方法 将 DL 编译器架构组织为前端、中端、后端三阶段，突出中端连接高层模型表示与硬件特化优化的角色；梳理代表性编译器与各阶段优化技术，并在 PyTorch/TorchInductor + NVIDIA RTX A6000 上实证考察图优化有效性、编译开销与动态形状处理。

关键数字 编译收益高度依赖工作负载特征：对融合友好计算图最高提速 8.21x，其他负载提升有限；编译开销需数千次执行才能摊平；动态形状编译以适度稳态性能损失换取累计形状转换成本约 70% 的降低。

为什么值得看 架构综述+实证数据双管齐下，回答了"编译器优化到底值多少"这个工程上常被夸大或低估的问题。

item.title: Data-Efficient Scaling-Law Discovery for Recommendation Systems via Coupled Hyperparameter Scaling
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

Large-scale ranking and recommendation models of Web platforms benefit from increased compute much as large language models do, and their scaling behavior is broadly power-law in f

Large-scale ranking and recommendation models of Web platforms benefit from increased compute much as large language models do, and their scaling behavior is broadly power-law in form. Yet ranking models have heterogeneous architectures which makes their scaling law less straightforward than that of LLMs. We address how to discover the scaling law of an arbitrary ranking model efficiently. We introduce a scaling layer, which groups primitive architecture parameters into semantically coherent groups and defines how they co-vary, inducing a mapping from a low-dimensional space of hyper-hyperparameters into the full architecture space. On top of it, Axia fits scaling-informed surrogates, selects configurations by a posterior-based acquisition criterion, and returns a Pareto frontier from which per-model operating points are validated -- replacing exhaustive sweeps with a small number of informative runs. A fleet-level evaluation protocol, computed on a fixed representative model set under matched trial budgets, makes refinements to either component measurable. Our contribution is an automated system that learns model-specific complexity-quality relationships and gives uncertainty-awar…

item.title: Coarse Semantic Blocks for Efficient Training-Free Sparse Attention
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 免训练稀疏注意力通常依赖逐 token 细粒度选择，prefill 与 decode 提速有限、精度损失大。能否用更粗粒度的语义块同时加速两阶段并保持精度？

方法 提出基于 prompt 专属 key 索引的免训练稀疏注意力：把 key 聚成覆盖非连续位置的大语义块，每个 query 按质心打分选块，再在块内对原始 key/value 做注意力；选择同一块的 query 分组处理，保持 prefill 速度。大块使质心打分与分组处理廉价，同等时间可让每个 query 关注更多 token。

关键数字 在 Qwen3.5-4B 与 35B-A3B 上（NVIDIA H200）：512K token 下相对 dense attention 整模型 wall-clock 提速 prefill 2.3-2.4x、decode 1.7-2.0x，1M 下 prefill 2.9-3.0x；35B-A3B 在五个 RULER 任务（至 1M）、LongBench-v2 与 MRCR（至 256K）上保持接近 dense 的精度。

为什么值得看 用"大语义块+分组处理"的思路把免训练稀疏注意力的 prefill 提速做到 2.4x 且精度接近 dense，是可落地的长上下文加速方案。

item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.DC)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

大规模 serverless 负载特征分析：跨平台 FaaS 工作负载的冷启动/弹性伸缩/调度洞察

Serverless computing is a popular approach to application deployment without having to manage the underlying infrastructure. Its most common implementation is Function-as-a-Service (FaaS), in which applications are structured as fine-grained functions. FaaS providers face non-trivial tasks in the management of their platforms, including cold starts, auto-scaling, and scheduling. The design of optimized platforms requires an accurate understanding of realistic serverless workloads. However, existing research and platforms rely on insights from single, often outdated datasets. In this work, we conduct a large-scale, cross-platform comparative analysis of eight publicly available FaaS workload traces from major cloud providers (Alibaba, Azure, Huawei, IBM) and a scientific computing platform (Globus). We provide a comprehensive and up-to-date view of the serverless ecosystem by characterizing key dimensions such as invocation patterns, latency, cold start behavior, and resource utilization. Our analysis shows that although invocation patterns remain universal, execution times have shortened, shifting the performance bottleneck toward platform scheduling and dependency management. We a…

item.title: Beyond Compression Ratio: High-Throughput KV Compression for Disaggregated LLM Serving
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.DC)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 KV cache 压缩能减少分离式（disaggregated）LLM 服务的通信量，但实际收益不仅取决于压缩比与模型质量，还取决于压缩流水线本身的执行效率——在高带宽互联下，低效压缩会抵消大部分省下的通信时间。

方法 提出 FastKVComp（构建于 KVServe 之上）：① 把分布变换与低比特量化融合进一个 KV-aware TileLang 内核，消除中间张量物化与冗余内存访问；② 用基于 LC 的开放、可扩展、可搜索后端替换原无损压缩后端。

关键数字 融合内核最高提速 5.9x；新无损后端把压缩吞吐从不足 90 GB/s 提升到 500 GB/s 以上；跨评估负载作业完成时间最高降低 2.04x。

为什么值得看 点明"压缩比之外的压缩性能"这个常被忽略的维度，在高带宽网络时代压缩管线的执行开销正在成为新瓶颈。

item.title: Best-of-Depth: Learning Exploratory Dynamics in Looped Transformers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

Best-of-Depth：把循环轨迹训练为候选集，按深度最小化预测损失提升循环 transformer 探索

Looped Transformers extend inference-time computation through repeated latent-state updates, but final-depth training does not directly encourage useful intermediate alternatives. We introduce Best-of-Depth (BoD), which trains a recurrent trajectory as a candidate set by minimizing prediction loss across depths. Different valid targets can be matched at different depths without architectural changes or depth-specific labels. An exact-match analysis connects this objective to solution coverage. On N-Queens completion and graph coloring, BoD improves coverage over final-depth and intermediate-supervision objectives. N-Queens coverage reaches 91.03%, versus 45.75% for final-depth training. Further experiments show discovery beyond the training depth and recovery of solutions withheld from teacher pools on familiar inputs. Fine-tuning a pretrained looped language model with BoD yields higher pooled code-generation success than final-depth training when programs are generated separately at evaluated fixed depths. These results support training recurrent computation for solution discovery along its trajectory.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Anchor: Augmented Cross-Layer Recurrent State for Long-Context Retrieval in Test-Time Training
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

Anchor：测试时训练的跨层循环状态增强长上下文检索，检索集中于少数锚定层

Parameter-efficient linearization turns a pretrained autoregressive Transformer into an efficient model by hybridizing sliding-window attention (SWA) with a constant-size recurrent memory. But does every layer's recurrent state contribute to long-context retrieval? Investigating an SWA and Test-Time Training (TTT) hybrid, we find that retrieval is sparse across depth, concentrated in a few anchor layers, and that the remaining states hold similar information expressed through layer-specific transformations. We exploit both observations in Anchor: TTT memory placed only at the anchor layers, and a cross-layer recurrent state written once and read by many layers, each through its own learned read map that realizes a layer-specific stretch and rotation, along with demonstrated generalization to other hybrid attentions. On Llama-3.1-8B and Mistral-7B, Anchor delivers 2.3-3.1x higher recall and 6.7-8.9 points higher MMLU accuracy than LoLCATs with a 10x smaller recurrent state, retains 91-95% of the teacher's MMLU accuracy, and cuts end-to-end latency by up to 4.3x relative to softmax attention.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Aligning Training and Rollout Policies for End-to-End FP4 RL on Mixture-of-Experts LLMs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 FP4 RL（强化学习后训练）低精度量化恢复配方在 dense 模型上有效，但在 MoE 大模型上照搬却对朴素 FP4 基线毫无改善，原因不明。

方法 深入分析定位到 MoE 特有的 router 机制：router 做离散专家选择，训练-推理策略对齐对"恢复技术是否在训练/推理两侧对称施加"高度敏感。不对称配方（含只修正 rollout 侧的 dense 方案）会导致训练与推理概率的 Pearson 相关系数、router 选择匹配率急剧恶化。据此提出 MoEResQ：强制训练侧与推理侧修正对称，恢复对齐并大幅缩小与全精度的精度差距。

关键数字 未给出具体量化指标；以训练/推理概率 Pearson 相关系数与 router 选择匹配率作为对齐度量，对称恢复显著缩小与全精度精度差距。

为什么值得看 首个指出 MoE 场景 FP4 RL 的关键原则是"对称恢复"，对低精度 RL 后训练管线设计有直接指导意义。

item.title: Aligning Language Models with General Preferences: An Empirical Study of Direct Nash Optimization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

通用偏好对齐实证：直接 Nash 优化 DNO-Prct 的独立复现研究

Direct Nash Optimization (DNO) aligns a language model to a general preference function by approximating the Nash equilibrium of a two-player preference game. Its practical variant, DNO-Prct, iterates on-policy sampling, LLM-based rating of the samples together with a teacher's gold response, large-margin preference-pair selection and a DPO-style contrastive update. We re-implement DNO-Prct independently and study it on two open-weight instruct models, Llama 3.1 8B Instruct and Mistral 7B Instruct v0.1, with GPT-4o or a larger open-weight model of the same family as the annotator. On AlpacaEval 2.0 with GPT-4o as judge, three iterations raise the length-controlled (LC) win rate against GPT-4o from 31.7% to 45.3% for Llama and from 6.8% to 18.4% for Mistral, and the tuned 8B model scores above Llama 3.1 70B Instruct on every reported win rate. With same-family open-weight annotators, the runs retain 62% (Llama) and 82% (Mistral) of the LC gain achieved with GPT-4o as annotator, so the rating step does not require a proprietary model. In a separate ablation configuration, variants that remove the gold responses, remove the data look-back, or accept only teacher-preferred pairs score …

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Accelerating Offloading-Based MoE Inference by Interleaving Concurrent Requests
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.DC)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 Expert offloading 让大 MoE 模型能在本地运行，但常规 batching 在拉取缺失专家时 GPU 空转；流行的 prefetching 方案需预测未来专家，预测不准反而浪费带宽和显存。

方法 关键发现：GPU 显存已有 expert cache 时 prefetching 可能有害（cache 越全，预测越不准）。核心洞察：合理的请求调度胜过预测。据此提出 Bevy：基于 runahead 推理，专家已就绪的请求可先行跑向后续层，从而暴露它下一步需要的专家；在计算就绪请求的同时按需拉取，计算与拉取重叠而无需预测。自平衡调度器逐层批量就绪请求并优先滞后请求，限制权重重复读带来的计算开销。

关键数字 在两个本地平台上，Bevy 的解码吞吐最高达 llama.cpp 的 3.46x、最快 prefetching 基线的 1.55x。

为什么值得看 用"调度取代预测"直接否定主流 prefetching 路线，对本地大 MoE 推理系统的设计有重要启示。

item.title: A RISC-V Simulator for the Tenstorrent Tensix Architecture
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.DC)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

Wolfpine：社区开发的 Tenstorrent Tensix 架构 RISC-V 模拟器，支持 Wormhole/Blackhole 两代

RISC-V based AI accelerators have become popular and not only for AI and ML, but also as vehicles for exploring HPC workloads more generally. Tenstorrent are one example, and whilst they document their Tensix architecture in detail and develop their software stack openly, running code has historically required a physical card, and their recently released simulator targets hardware equivalence rather than introspection. In this paper we present Wolfpine, a community developed RISC-V simulator for the Tensix architecture, supporting both the Wormhole and Blackhole generations and integrating seamlessly with the TT-Metal software stack. Constructed entirely from publicly available documentation, open source software and measurements on physical hardware, Wolfpine is written in pure Python for readability and ease of modification. An opt-in, provenance-tracked cost model adds timing fidelity incrementally, and typed event streams, per-component tracing and timeline export enable programmers to identify and diagnose performance bottlenecks that the hardware itself hides.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: 世界初、STT-MRAMを搭載した16nm AI SoCを開発―電源投入から65.7ミリ秒で物体検出AIモジュールを高速起動、従来比1/50の低消費エネルギーで物体検出を実現―
item.description:
发表方：东北大学　发布：2026-11-02　分类：官方公告 / 每日精选

核心话题 东北大学 CIES 与爱信开发世界首个搭载 32MB 嵌入式 STT-MRAM 的 16nm FinFET AI SoC（近内存计算），无需外部 DRAM/SSD。

要点 AI 权重与 OS 启动数据都存入片上 STT-MRAM，省去上电时外部数据传输；8/16 位混合乘法与权重共享在有限容量运行 Tiny YOLOv3；成果发表于 A-SSCC 2026。

关键数字 上电到 OS 启动 65.7ms（快 38.59x）；系统整体提速 25.2x；物体检测能耗 50.7 mJ/frame（约 1/50）。

为什么值得看 近内存计算落地实例，为边缘 AI 即时启动与低能耗提供芯片级方案。

item.title: When Latent Dynamics Meet Data Assimilation: A Benchmark of Koopman-Type Representations
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-02　分类：论文PDF

潜在动力学遇上数据同化：Koopman 类表示的基准比较（7 方法 5 系统）

Koopman representations describe nonlinear dynamics through linear evolution in a transformed space, offering an attractive framework for their linear simplicity and generality. Yet these advantages do not necessarily translate into improved performance in deep latent data assimilation (LDA). We systematically compare seven representative methods and structural baselines across five systems spanning approximately periodic to strongly chaotic dynamics and a broad range of state dimensions. We evaluate forecast and assimilation accuracy, physical state recovery, latent-trajectory behavior, and dynamical consistency, and assess Gaussian error assumptions, objective convexity, and uniqueness of analysis solutions. Our results reveal a trade-off between representational flexibility and optimization tractability. Linear evolution of the latent state can stabilize short-term forecasts but restrict expressiveness in strongly chaotic and high-dimensional systems, without consistently improving assimilation accuracy. Parameterized linear operators offer greater flexibility, yet their joint optimization with the encoder--decoder remains nonconvex. Methods with closed-form analysis updates gen…

item.title: When Does Adaptive Halting Win? Selection Rules Matter in Looped Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-02　分类：论文PDF

Looped language models can stop iterating early, and recent work shows that post-hoc readouts of the loop trajectory often rival the learned exit gate of the looped model Ouro. Such comparisons reduce each method to one operating point chosen by a selection rule. We ask whether that rule decides the outcome. On a frozen Ouro-1.4B with four loops, we compared a trained stability probe ($π_1$-x) with Ouro's native gate, adapted to a per-question stopping decision, in pre-registered studies; the confirmatory study was designed after an exploratory finding on development data and evaluated once on a sealed test set of 8,517 questions. In the pre-registered confirmatory comparison, which selected operating points with a bootstrap-screened 1 pp accuracy-loss rule, the probe saved more of the four-loop budget than the native gate (+0.053 gross macro saving over three benchmarks, 95% CI [+0.049, +0.057]), mostly from CommonsenseQA, where the probe's test upper bound on accuracy loss exceeded 1 pp. Under a point-only rule, a pre-specified secondary analysis on the same test set reversed the preference (-0.022 [-0.026, -0.018]), with operating points that exceeded the budget. item.title: When Cache Pressure Becomes a Trap: Metastability in Agent Serving
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.DC)　发布：2026-11-02　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 LLM agent 反复发送不断增长的对话，前缀复用是高效服务的核心；但短暂负载突发可能破坏复用并触发 prefill-decode 分离引擎的亚稳态失效——负载回落、服务仍持续退化。

方法 实证 SGLang 上的突发影响，并用流体模型识别"群体-缓存反馈"机制（慢调用延长会话、扩大工作集、缓存缺失增加重算、进一步延迟离开）；据此构建 Basin 防护系统：每会话固定优先级、按预测峰值上下文预留自适应准入预算、用空闲解码内存扩展缓存、过载时弃流。

关键数字 SGLang 上 10 分钟突发使随后 1 小时 goodput 下降约 88%，移除残余突发会话后数分钟内恢复；流体模型在 36 个模拟部署中识别出全部 17 个 cache-first 案例。

为什么值得看 揭示 agent serving 亚稳态失效的机制与防护系统，真实 H200 部署验证。

item.title: ViAdminShift: A Vietnamese Benchmark for Event-Level Knowledge Updates Built from the 2025 Administrative Reform
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-02　分类：论文PDF

On July 1, 2025, Vietnam reduced its 63 provinces to 34, abolished its 696 districts, and replaced its 10,035 commune-level units (wards) with 3,321. ViAdminShift, a Vietnamese language resource about this event, consists of 7,995 benchmark items, 2,281 retrieval passages from pre- and post-reform Wikipedia revisions and dated templates, and old-to-new tables that a released script rebuilds from the official conversion table (not redistributed). Changed items store the pre-reform answer (except 121 address items), a $2\times2$ design uses untouched units as controls, and 400 addresses appear without diacritics. The tables agree with an independent lineage on 10,564 of 10,565 official pairs, disagreements were settled against the resolutions, and the probing-track scorer agrees with both authors' blind labels (Cohen's $κ=0.91$ and $0.89$). Data, outputs, code, and a datasheet are released. In the probing track, at least 20 of 67 models know the reform. Fourteen of them give the new province alone for at most 11% of plain questions about old addresses (old province only: 14-100%); a bare date recovers up to 100%. item.title: Vectorizing Recurrences over Semirings
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.PL)　发布：2026-11-02　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 递归在信号/图像处理、生信、数值计算与组合优化中无处不在，但看似固有串行，常被串行实现而未能利用现代硬件的向量指令。

方法 提出半环上递归的代数框架，研究使向量化成立的代数恒等式，并给出多种向量化变换（自然扩展到 2D 递归与互递归）；将该代数与变换实现为编译器 VecRec，把递归程序编译为高效的向量化 C++ 代码。

关键数字 生成内核在多种递归上相对串行实现最高达一个数量级加速；生信案例研究显示与手工向量化库竞争、多数场景更优。

为什么值得看 从代数理论到实用编译器，系统性解锁递归程序向量化，跨多个领域受益。

item.title: Utility-Aware Generative Recommendation: Utility-Enriched Semantic Codes and Utility-Guided Decoding
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-02　分类：论文PDF

Generative recommendation has been widely adopted in large-scale industrial recommendation systems, where multimodal item embeddings are quantized into offline semantic identifiers (SIDs) and items are retrieved by autoregressively generating their SIDs. However, conventional SID construction often underrepresents item utility reflected in post-exposure behaviors such as shares, long views, and video completion, making semantically similar items with different utility insufficiently distinguishable while struggling to accommodate rapidly changing utility signals. Moreover, generation likelihood may be misaligned with downstream utility, causing high-utility candidates to be prematurely pruned during beam search before post-generation reranking or training-time reward alignment can effectively compensate. To address these limitations, we propose UAGR, which aligns both SID construction and decoding with downstream multi-objective utility. Our Utility-Enriched Semantic Codes preserve the original semantic information while incorporating item-level utility without increasing SID length or vocabulary size, supporting incremental utility updates with no additional tokenization or sequen…

item.title: Unlocking Turing Tensor Cores: A Measured Throughput Account of From-Scratch Pre-training on a Single 22G RTX 2080 Ti
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-02　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：RTX 2080 Ti（TU102）硬件上完整搭载第二代 Tensor Core，但驱动层限制 FP16 矩阵乘，可用张量吞吐远低于硬件峰值——解锁驱动限制能带来多少真实收益？

方法：turing-unlock 内核模块在 nvidia 驱动绑定设备前写入 FP16 速率选择器（SS0=0x88888888、SS1=0x8）并释放 ACR 互斥锁；在同一 22G 2080 Ti 上、同一套从零预训练协议下做解锁前后吞吐对照。

关键数字：cuBLAS FP16 matmul 从 55.7 提升到 91.4 TFLOPS（约 1.6x）；small tier（75.7M 参数）稳态吞吐从 6480 到 7246 tok/s（+11.8%），墙钟时间 1.77h 降到 1.61h（省 9.0%）；tiny tier +4.7%；pico-micro 三档最多 +0.3%；逐层峰值内存与最终质量指标逐位一致。

为什么值得看：解锁收益随矩阵规模单调上升，是纯吞吐收益、不扰动训练动态——为「驱动级限制掩盖硬件能力」提供了可复现的量化证据。

原文：Unlocking Turing Tensor Cores: A Measured Throughput Account of From-Scratch Pre-training on a Single 22G RTX 2080 Ti

item.title: Turbo-GMM: FlashAttention-Inspired GPU-Accelerated Gaussian Mixture Model
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-02　分类：论文PDF

Expectation-maximization (EM) for Gaussian mixture models (GMMs) requires scoring $N$ data points against $K$ mixture components. Prior fused GPU implementations, notably Flash-GMM, eliminate materialization of the $N \times K$ responsibility matrix but traverse the component dimension twice to compute normalization terms and accumulate sufficient statistics. We introduce Turbo-GMM, a single-sweep fused EM kernel that completes responsibility normalization and sufficient-statistic accumulation within one traversal of the component dimension. By retaining the complete component axis on chip, Turbo-GMM avoids the second score computation required by the released two-sweep Flash-GMM implementation. Its applicability is limited by register pressure, occupancy, and the component and feature dimensions, making it particularly suitable for large datasets with relatively small numbers of components. For larger configurations, Turbo-GMM employs a two-pass fallback following the established fused design. We establish algebraic equivalence to standard EM in real arithmetic and evaluate sixteen configurations on an NVIDIA A100. Under the reported benchmarking protocol, Turbo-GMM achieves a med…

item.title: Training Autoregressive Language Models on Rounded, Bounded, and Censored Numerical Labels via Exact Likelihood
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-02　分类：论文PDF

Numerical labels often specify a set of possible values: a measurement is rounded, a laboratory test reports only a bound, or a program is stopped at a timeout. We introduce boundary marginalization, the first method that trains an autoregressive language model on the exact likelihood of such observations through its existing digit tokens. A fixed-width, order-preserving numeral representation groups consecutive grid values under shared digit prefixes. An interval is a union of such groups, so its exact probability and gradient follow from at most two boundary paths, the successive digit prefixes of its endpoints, each of length logarithmic in the number of grid values. The resulting objective unifies precise, rounded, bounded, and censored supervision and trains digit decisions at the resolution supplied by each observation. The same computation supports exact distributional queries and unbiased gradients for the continuous ranked probability score on exact labels. Experiments show recovery of a conditional distribution from rounded and censored reports alone, improved likelihood on naturally censored molecular measurements, and more accurate code latency distributions on two back…

item.title: Train the Sampler You Run: Few-Step Masked Diffusion Language Models via Mixture-Likelihood Fine-Tuning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-02　分类：论文PDF

When a masked diffusion language model is sampled in a few parallel steps in a random order, the model actually run is a mixture over reveal plans, while cross-entropy training fits token conditionals rather than this mixture. We introduce mixture-likelihood fine-tuning (Mix-FT), which fine-tunes a pretrained model on an importance-weighted bound of its own sampler's likelihood, with no teacher and no change to the architecture or the sampler. On LLaDA-8B, a LoRA fine-tune for 0.002% of the pretraining compute writes better OpenWebText continuations than continued cross-entropy and Alpha diffusion given the same compute, at every tested step count. With half the model evaluations, 16 rather than 32 steps per block, its continuations score better than the original model's in every seed under three judges, with confidence-based decoding as well as random order, and under confidence-based decoding two blinded LLM raters from different model families prefer them in 69 and 71% of pairs. On a public 110M-parameter block diffusion model, Mix-FT takes under four T4-hours and beats continued cross-entropy, Alpha diffusion and SDTT distillation at 4, 8 and 16 steps per block, under two judge…

item.title: TinyML Hits the Memory Wall: A Benchmark of Ten Sub-Watt Edge Devices
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.AR)　发布：2026-11-02　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 边缘神经网络推理受能量预算约束；现有基准设备少、能耗口径不统一，且遗漏带 NPU 的 MCU 与 1 GHz Cortex-M85；硬件感知设计以 MAC 数排名网络，但该代理是否成立未经检验。

方法 在 10 款亚瓦级商用设备上实测 4 个 CNN（MobileNetV3、MCUNetV1、EfficientNet、SqueezeNet）与 2 个小 transformer（MobileViT-XXS、DeiT-tiny），含 4 款带 NPU 的 MCU、传感器内 DSP 与 5 款无 NPU MCU，能耗按"高于空闲"统一口径。

关键数字 IMX500 每模型 0.13–0.35 mJ，比 STM32N6（0.31–1.05 mJ）少 1.3–3 倍能耗；四款加速器比 STM32V8 少 6–34 倍能耗；加速器延迟随内存流量（r≥0.98）而非 MAC 缩放；NPU 相对 1 GHz Cortex-M85 的优势从 MCUNetV1 的 1.4 倍到 SqueezeNet 的 8.2 倍。

为什么值得看 首个统一能耗口径的亚瓦级多设备基准，实证 MAC 计数是误导性成本代理。

item.title: Time-Aware Urban Flood Routing with Sticky Edge Closure on Forecast Depth: A Hanoi Case Study
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.DC)　发布：2026-11-02　分类：论文PDF

During urban flash floods, commuters and guiding agencies require awareness towards which roads remain passable when a vehicle actually arrives, rather than relying solely on which links appear open at initial departure. Most existing flood-routing tools apply a single static snapshot to each route; meaning that corridors that appear clear initially can become flooded before arrival. This paper presents a routing engine that ingests a two-hour water forecast, renewed every 15 minutes, and plans each journey around roads that the forecast closes for that specific vehicle class. Under this formulation, any road that closes mid-trip remains closed for that query, which keeps route calculation fast enough for live requests while operating inside a production GraphHopper routing server. Testing on a recorded storm in western Hanoi revealed that a router checking only departure conditions sent 7.8% of routes into roads flooded upon arrival. In comparable trips, the proposed rule produced longer routes in 3.95% of cases, requiring a median of only 9.2 s of additional travel time. Agencies and navigation platforms can employ this engine to schedule trips by vehicle type, allowing operators…

item.title: The role of injected noise in diffusion model generalization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-02　分类：论文PDF

注入噪声在扩散模型泛化中的作用：采样期噪声决定跨数据集泛化

Diffusion models trained on distinct datasets can produce highly similar samples when prompted with the same noise input, suggesting that they learn a generalized data distribution. We investigate the role of noise injected during the sampling process, and show that it plays an important role in making or breaking this strong generalization effect. Based on this finding we investigate the robustness of sample similarity to changes in the injected noise, and find that its impact is largest in the sampling regime where broad structure already exists but the precise identity of the sample is not yet determined.

item.title: The Information Limits of Neural Controlled Differential Equations Under Sparse Observations
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-02　分类：论文PDF

稀疏观测下神经受控微分方程的信息极限：平面驱动有界速度的歧义刻画

Neural controlled differential equations (Neural CDEs) evolve hidden states along continuous paths constructed by interpolating discrete observations. Sparse measurements leave the input between observation times undetermined, and admissible continuous paths consistent with the same data can produce different terminal states. We characterize this ambiguity for planar drivers with bounded speed. The set of compatible terminal states admits a leading-order zonotopic approximation determined by feasible signed areas and transported Lie brackets. Its projection onto a scalar prediction yields a computable, target-specific ambiguity certificate. We also study the number of measurements needed to reduce the remaining uncertainty. For nondegenerate planar CDEs, the optimal worst-case radius over deterministic adaptive sampling policies scales as $N^{-1}$ when speed is bounded and $N^{-2}$ when both speed and acceleration are bounded, where $N$ is the number of observation intervals. Synthetic experiments assess the certificate using admissible continuous completions and examine the role of path regularity.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: TensorLOB: Structure-Preserving Tensor Learning for Limit Order Book Forecasting
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-02　分类：论文PDF

The limit order book (LOB) records outstanding buy and sell orders across multiple price levels. Its state evolves over time across market side, price level, and order attribute, naturally forming a multiway structure. However, existing LOB models typically flatten these dimensions into a matrix model, thus obscuring the existing structural relationships. Starting from first principles and the market-microstructure intuition of the LOB, we design TensorLOB to operate entirely in the tensor domain. TensorLOB uses mode-wise tensor contractions for feature extraction and directly contracts the learned representation with low-rank class-weight tensors for prediction, retaining the distinct roles of time, side, level, and attribute modes. Experiments on the FI-2010 benchmark show that TensorLOB achieves the highest accuracy, recall, and F1 score across all four evaluated horizons. This proof of concept highlights the potential of high-dimensional modelling of multi-way latent information intrinsic to financial markets, which has so far been largely overlooked.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Temporal Island Sparse Autoencoders for Interpreting Clinical Time-Series Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-02　分类：论文PDF

Deep learning models for electronic health records achieve strong predictive performance but provide little insight into what clinical concepts they represent internally. Post-hoc attribution methods produce per-cell importance scores that lack temporal coherence, cross-variable structure, and reusability across patients. We introduce the Temporal Island Sparse Autoencoder (TI-SAE), which learns a backbone-specific, patient-shared clinical concept dictionary from a frozen predictive model's representations. Each dictionary entry (latent) is defined by learned temporal Gaussian islands (specifying when the concept is active) and a sparse variable-composition vector (specifying which variables are involved). A decoupled selector then identifies which dictionary entries drive each patient's prediction, separating representation learning from attribution. We evaluate TI-SAE across five backbone architectures spanning different representation strategies on MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV (three prediction tasks each). TI-SAE produces structured clinical concepts that go beyond transient attribution heatmaps while achieving strong performance on standard faithfulness benchmarks.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: TSB-SEG: A Systematic Time-Series Segmentation Benchmark
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-02　分类：论文PDF

Time-series segmentation, studied as either Change Point Detection (CPD) or State Detection (SD), underpins a broad range of monitoring and diagnostic applications. However, the field suffers from a persistent divide between the statistical community (focusing on CPD) and the machine learning and data mining communities (focusing on SD). Consequently, the literature remains fragmented: evaluations typically cover narrow methodological families, datasets are often small or homogeneous, and CPD and SD are rarely evaluated together. We address these gaps with TSB-SEG, a unified benchmark comprising 592 univariate and multivariate time series from 8 heterogeneous datasets and surveying 26 algorithms that span five decades of progress. To ensure a fair comparison, we introduce a two-pool design: a scalable main pool of tractable detectors used for the aggregate ranking, and an extended-scope pool for computationally intensive methods. All methods are unified under tsseg, an open-source library to ensure full reproducibility. Our systematic evaluation yields three insights: (a) no single detector dominates across domains, and per-dataset hyperparameter tuning remains decisive for perform…

TB-Transolver：时序捆绑并行化长程 rollout，解决时间相关 PDE 的串行执行模型

Transolver has recently gained widespread adoption for solving diverse physical problems on unstructured geometric meshes by leveraging its Physics-Attention mechanism, which seamlessly extends standard softmax attention to handle physical domains at scale. For time-dependent problems, existing literature relies on time-conditioned or autoregressive rollouts to preserve temporal causality while retaining Physics-Attention as the spatial backbone. However, a fundamental limitation of this formulation is its sequential execution model, wherein computational costs scale linearly with the temporal horizon, rendering standard Transolver inefficient for transient problems despite its exceptional spatial efficacy. This bottleneck has historically hindered its broader application in time-dependent physical modeling. item.title: Spectral Degeneration of Self-Attention under Isotropic Score Geometry
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-02　分类：论文PDF

We study the spectral structure of the self-attention matrix in Transformer models through an idealized spectral model for the pre-softmax score matrix. Motivated by the rotational isotropy of query and key representations, our model replaces the random token-space orientation of the score matrix by its canonical singular-value representative with a logarithmic spike--bulk separation. Empirical diagnostics on pretrained vision and language transformers motivate this model: token-space singular matrices have nearly uniform eigen-angle distributions, and score spectra are dominated by a small number of effective directions. We then prove that the row-wise softmax map transforms this structure into a degenerate attention matrix: dominant modes are preserved, whereas the bulk spectral distributions concentrate at zero. Stable rank remains bounded for bidirectional attention but grows logarithmically for causal attention. Within the canonical model, these results explain how attention can preserve a small number of dominant directions while compressing the remaining bulk modes.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: SpecPilot: Autonomous Algorithm Discovery and Systems Optimization for Speculative Decoding
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-02　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 并行 drafter 让投机解码一次前向起草整块 token，但发布系统未必达到并行起草允许的全部加速；且投机解码强依赖部署场景，无普适最优配置。

方法 SpecPilot：自主 agentic 优化循环——每轮成本模型定位当前系统与其上限的最大差距，并行探索方向并整合成功者；token forcing 逐 token 对照 stock 检测 reward hacking；结构化记忆把验证过的机制带到新轮次与新部署。由此自动发现通用无损 12-bit 权重格式、混合递归目标的树验证、两级验证与三种批处理机制。

关键数字 四个目标模型、三个 drafter、两个 GPU 平台、五个基准评估：相对自回归解码的加速比从 stock 的 4.46 倍提升到 10.87 倍（单请求），批量场景从 1.94 倍到 3.93 倍，全程无训练且无质量损失。

为什么值得看 用 agentic 循环自动发现部署特化优化，示范"系统优化自动化"的新范式。

item.title: Sonar-MoE: In-Backward Expert Updates for Memory-Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Training
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-02　分类：论文PDF

Most parameters of a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model belong to its experts, and standard training keeps every expert gradient in GPU memory until the optimizer step. This memory grows with the number and size of the experts, so it rises as MoE models scale. We introduce Sonar-MoE, which updates each expert tensor during the backward pass and frees its gradient right away. It brings optimizer-in-backward from dense models to batched MoE expert tensors, so the GPU never holds more than one layer of expert gradients. When we fine-tune OLMoE-1B-7B and Granite-3.1-3B-A800M in bf16 with two expert-kernel backends, Sonar-MoE lowers peak memory by 19% to 22%. Its updates are bitwise identical to standard training without expert gradient clipping, and held-out loss stays within 0.003 of all baselines. Each step also takes 17% to 23% less time than standard training with global-norm clipping. Updating whole batched tensors rather than individual experts is what keeps Sonar-MoE fast, as it avoids a 20% to 72% slowdown while using the same memory. Sonar-MoE matches optimizer-in-backward over all parameters in memory and speed while still clipping the dense parameters.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Silent Degradation during Auto-Vectorization of bf16/fp16 on RISC-V Under LLVM
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.PL)　发布：2026-11-02　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 LLVM 的 RISC-V 自动向量化（RVV）对低精度类型（int8/bf16/fp16）处理是否同样良好？以乘加循环为测试对象，检查在常见基线 target（-march=rv64gcv）下的向量化行为。

方法 对比 fp32、int8、bf16、fp16 四种类型的自动向量化结果，结合 QEMU 用户态模拟的动态指令计数、汇编级指令分析及 LLVM optimization remarks 诊断。

关键数字 int8 与 fp32 干净向量化；bf16/fp16 退化为标量为主的回退代码，fp16 甚至回退到逐元素软件转换调用（除非启用 zvfbfmin/zvfbfwma、zvfhmin 扩展）。基线 bf16/fp16 内核的动态指令数分别是启用扩展版本的 17.0x 与 75.9x。编译器诊断虽报告退化，但措辞不区分"flag 可完全解决的限制"与"固有权转换成本"。

为什么值得看 揭示低精度 AI 推理在 RVV 上的"静默退化"陷阱：同样的代码在 int8/fp32 向量化良好，换 bf16/fp16 就悄悄变慢，且诊断信息不足以指导修复。

item.title: Semantic Caches for LLM Web Services Leave Their Error Budget Unspent
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-02　分类：论文PDF

Web services built on large language models (LLMs) receive many paraphrases of earlier queries, which a semantic cache answers from stored responses. A reused answer can be wrong, so wrong answers must stay below a share $δ$ of the queries. Existing caches reuse above a fixed similarity threshold or, like vCache, learn a per-entry rule that bounds each query's error by $δ$. However, fixed thresholds break the budget on new streams, and per-entry rules need labels on every entry before reusing it. We find an unspent error budget, as vCache realizes only 12-55% of $δ$ on three public query streams. Surplus spends this budget where reuse is most likely correct. It ranks queries by a risk score shared across paraphrase clusters and opens risk bins as far as an audited error estimate allows. Free labels from every LLM call and a ledger of realized errors keep this threshold safe under drift. On five streams, including ORCAS search queries, Surplus holds $δ$ in every test cell, which no baseline does. On the shuffled streams it serves 40% more hits than vCache, and its pooled hit rate beats the best baseline holding $δ$ in each cell by 4.10 points. In a vLLM testbed it cuts the mean late…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Same Function, Different CPU: Quantifying Hardware Heterogeneity in Commercial FaaS Platforms
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.DC)　发布：2026-11-02　分类：论文PDF

Serverless computing, particularly Function-as-a-Service (FaaS), abstracts operational concerns such as scaling, scheduling, and resource management from users. This abstraction, however, conceals a heterogeneous hardware fleet on which function execution environments are scheduled behind a unified function interface. Consequently, otherwise identical invocations may run on different CPU types that differ in performance, a hardware lottery that users can neither see nor control. Since the resulting variability is entangled with other sources, such as noisy neighbors or diurnal effects, its contribution to overall performance variability and how this contribution differs across providers remain unclear. In this paper, we systematically study hardware heterogeneity and its impact on function performance across four widely used commercial FaaS platforms, covering regional, configurational, and temporal differences. Using variance decomposition, we find that CPU heterogeneity alone explains 4 % to 97 % of the performance variance on AWS Lambda and Google Cloud Run Functions. On Azure Functions, in contrast, we identify a platform-level mechanism that produces bimodal execution duration…

item.title: SHq: Learnable Grids for LLM Weight Quantization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-02　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 块缩放查找表（LUT）量化格式以索引表示权重，grid 定义本应灵活；但现有实现依赖固定 grid（INT/FP/NF/BOF），且不存在普遍最优的单一固定 grid。

方法 SHq 提出闭式 grid 家族，含两个自由度：压扩强度 α（在均匀与浮点式间距间插值）与偏移 c（引入不对称）；偏移让 FP8 块缩放中未用的符号位选择 grid 或其镜像，使每块可用不同值数量最多翻倍。SHq 只改查找表内容，可作任意此类格式的 drop-in 替换。

关键数字 五个模型（3B–35B，含 MoE）在 2–6 bits、RTN/GPTQ 下评估：3、4 bits 全部设置 KL 散度最低，多数 2、5、6 bits 设置亦最低；比最佳固定 grid 最高优 34%；4.5 bits 时相对 NVFP4 KL 降 41–67%。

为什么值得看 统一视角解释 LUT 格式 grid 设计的两自由度，即插即用且实测全面占优。

item.title: SCARF: A Scene-Adaptive Depth-Guided G-3DGS Encoder Accelerator with Semantic Reuse and Fused Dataflow
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.AR)　发布：2026-11-02　分类：论文PDF

Depth-guided, cost-volume-based Generalizable 3D Gaussian Splatting (G-3DGS) encoders reconstruct scenes as sets of Gaussian primitives directly from multi-view images without requiring per-scene optimization, thereby facilitating feed-forward novel-view synthesis on edge computing platforms. However, their shared encoder architecture presents two primary bottlenecks. First, the per-pixel depth search disregards semantic similarity within the 2D feature space, causing depth search operations to account for over 65% of memory traffic due to redundant exhaustive candidate scans. Second, the sequential pipeline of depth prediction followed by Gaussian generation neglects local 3D geometric continuity, resulting in more than 52% of generated Gaussians being redundant prior to instantiation. In this paper, we introduce SCARF, a dataflow-co-designed accelerator that aligns each bottleneck with a corresponding scene-level regularity. To mitigate the first bottleneck, Feature Similarity Depth Reuse reconceptualizes depth search as a problem of semantic locality: depth consistency is determined by affinity in feature space rather than physical address proximity. It transforms exhaustive per…

item.title: Rose: Efficient Embodied RL through Graph Optimization and GPU Compute Resource Control
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.DC)　发布：2026-11-02　分类：论文PDF

Embodied reinforcement learning (RL) coordinates policy inference, simulation, and model training with highly heterogeneous resource demands. Although individual components frequently underutilize GPU compute during execution, existing systems only overlap work at coarse component boundaries (e.g., pipelining inference and simulation across simulator groups), leaving substantial low-activity GPU windows within subcomponent phases and nested loops. Exploiting these fine-grained windows manually requires tedious dependency analysis and workload-specific coordination. Furthermore, even when independent work is scheduled concurrently, cross-process GPU time slicing and streaming multiprocessor (SM) contention can negate the benefits of overlap. We present Rose, a runtime-aware system that automates fine-grained overlap and GPU resource management for embodied RL while preserving synchronous training semantics. Through a lightweight programmable interface that exposes execution hierarchy and state accesses, Rose tracks runtime data readiness and GPU activity to perform a two-stage optimization. First, a window-guided graph optimizer identifies low-activity windows and applies graph tran…

item.title: Rethinking Fairness Metrics for Multi-Class and Multi-Group Assessment: Not Everything is Binary
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-02　分类：论文PDF

Artificial Intelligence, and Machine Learning in general, is becoming pervasive across all domains and disciplines. By means of this data-driven approach, algorithms can learns complex task just by learning from samples. However, if the data-set is biased, they might lead to the development of unfair computer systems, that is, characterised by a prejudice towards specific individuals or groups, which might get an unmotivated output from the system. This circumstance lead to the development of multiple metrics designed to quantify the level of unfairness of an algorithm. However, a generalised assumption in the literature is that the sensitive features and the output labels are binary. When the data is not binary, it is forcefully binarized using a one-versus-the-rest simplification. In this work, we discuss the limitations of existing metrics and propose novel, mathematically sound, and generalized multi-group and multi-class formulations of the metrics. Ultimately, our results highlight the empirical assessment distortion caused by binarization strategies, which reveals the limitations of binary fairness metrics in the multi class setting.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Replay for LLM Continual Learning with Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-02　分类：论文PDF

Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) distills domain experts into one student but needs every expert at once. When domains arrive one at a time and earlier experts are gone, the previous-stage student can teach replayed prompts of earlier domains inside every stage. Some pipelines instead store every stage snapshot for a final multi-teacher recovery stage. On five domains with a 1.5B student and five public experts, this paper compares both with joint MOPD. It varies the replay budget and the replay signal. The signal is token-level distillation alone or with alignment of hidden states, attention and value relations. Sequential distillation without replay or recovery is 6.2 points below 208-step joint MOPD on a 14-benchmark average and 3.5 points below on the 11 benchmarks outside safety. Without snapshots, replay toward the previous student closes 3.8 of the 6.2 points when the earlier domains share the replay budget of a stage. With a fixed share of seven replay steps per earlier domain and stage, it closes 5.8 over two training runs. This is level with the 5.9 of recovery from all snapshots, both at its default length and when given as many training steps as the fixed sha…

item.title: RASP: Read-All, Sparse-Plasticity Continual Learning in a Stationary-Size LoRA
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-02　分类：论文PDF

Parameter-efficient continual learning on pre-trained Vision Transformers largely relies on a costly premise: preventing catastrophic forgetting requires either spawning a dedicated LoRA branch per session---causing adapter parameters to scale linearly with task horizon---or applying sparse Mixture-of-Experts gating symmetrically to both forward and backward passes, which sacrifices representational rank at test time. We argue that reading consolidated knowledge and writing new task credit are fundamentally asymmetric operations. Because visual features in a shared low-rank space distribute across rank-1 atoms rather than localizing in disjoint task silos, forward inference should read all atoms at full rank capacity, whereas backward optimization should restrict plasticity to a sparse subset of input-aligned channels. We introduce RASP (Read-All, Sparse-Plasticity LoRA), which adapts a single stationary-size adapter across sequential tasks. At each step, a scene-modulated cosine router selects the top-$q$ unlocked atoms to receive gradients, blocks updates on the remaining $r-q$ channels, and penalizes Frobenius Gram coherence between active and non-updated output directions. item.title: RAPID: Increasing Efficiency of Internal Distillation via Randomized Methods
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-02　分类：论文PDF

RAPID：随机化方法提升内部蒸馏效率，替代教师激活投影的可学习矩阵

Knowledge distillation is a technique used to transfer the expertise of large teacher models into small, efficient student models. Recent advances have integrated the distillation of internal activations, more directly training students to learn similar representations as the teacher. One of the core challenges of internal distillation is the dimensional incompatibility between the student and teacher internal representations. Existing methods add learnable matrices to project the larger teacher activations into the smaller representation space of the student. This is a notable point of inefficiency, as learning additional parameters for the projectors increases training costs, only for them to be discarded immediately after training. We introduce RAPID (RAndomized Projection for Internal Distillation) a novel distillation methodology which eliminates the wasteful projection learning by leveraging randomized methods. RAPID utilizes an efficient transform construction based on the Johnson-Lindenstrauss lemma to compress the teacher representations into the student embedding space with strong theoretical guarantees of structural preservation. item.title: Quantifying out-of-distribution data severity with Wasserstein distances: benchmarking large language models for alloy property prediction
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-02　分类：论文PDF

Wasserstein 距离量化 OOD 严重性：通用 LLM 与材料专用模型性质预测基准

As general-purpose Large Language Models (LLMs), such as Gemini and DeepSeek, exhibit increasingly advanced reasoning capabilities, a critical question arises: how do their property prediction abilities compare to those of domain-specific pretrained materials models? In this study, we evaluate predictions for Ti, steels, high-entropy alloy (HEA) and Al, demonstrating that general-purpose LLMs surprisingly outperform SteelBERT, MatSciBERT, and SciBERT. To further enhance performance, we introduce a hybrid approach that utilizes numerical priors from a prior model, such as CatBoost or SteelBERT, to guide the general LLMs (Deepseek V3.1, Gemini-2.5-Flash). By inputting these initial estimates from a prior model as prompts, the LLM acts as a reasoning corrector, achieving accuracy superior to the prior model and "unguided mode". Furthermore, we investigate the impact of data strategy using a similarity-based metric, revealing that data quality dominates quantity; using merely 5% of high-similarity reference data of training set as input yields performance similar to the results of using 100% of training set. item.title: Qualcomm HBC demonstrates AI inference leadership with validated silicon
item.description:
发表方：Qualcomm OnQ Blog　发布：2026-11-02　分类：技术博客 / 每日精选

核心话题： 高通第一代 HBC（High Bandwidth Compute）近存计算芯片完成硬件验证。 要点： 在圣地亚哥实验室用行业标准自动测试设备驱动生产级代表性数据通路，完整内存读写路径与近存计算实测通过；技术栈涵盖验证过的架构、wafer-to-wafer 键合工艺、内建冗余/重映射韧性、量产路径与活跃产品集成（数据中心产品已 tape out，bonded DRAM 层逻辑基带 bring-up 已有产出）。 关键数字： 近存计算把计算移到内存旁以减少数据搬运、提升有效带宽，目标改善 AI 推理的每瓦性能。 为什么值得看： 官方首个 HBC 硅片"生命证明"，近存计算从架构走向量产的关键节点，AI 推理内存墙路线的直接信号。

item.title: Pretraining Data Scale Reverses the Muon-AdamW Fine-Tuning Gap
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-02　分类：论文PDF

Muon has recently emerged as a promising optimizer for pretraining large language models, offering a speedup over AdamW in minimizing pretraining loss. However, it remains unclear whether Muon's advantage persists after fine-tuning. In this paper, we study the downstream behavior of Muon and AdamW and uncover a surprising trend: beyond a sufficiently large pretraining data budget, AdamW outperforms Muon after fine-tuning. Moreover, as model size increases, AdamW overtakes Muon at progressively smaller pretraining token-parameter ratios. To explain this reversal, we view fine-tuning as a perturbation of the outputs and introduce the margin-to-spread ratio, which measures how far the correct logit lies above the wrong ones relative to how widely the wrong logits are spread. In language models, Muon has the larger margin-to-spread ratio at small data budgets and AdamW at large ones, mirroring the fine-tuning trend. In a linear associative memory, we prove that after one update the margin-to-spread ratio of gradient descent gains on that of Muon as the data budget grows, and simulations show that this trend persists after extended training.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Part 2: FP8 Instructions for Arm Advanced SIMD, SVE, and SME
item.description:
发表方：Arm Community Blog　发布：2026-11-02　分类：技术博客 / 每日精选

核心话题：FP8 指令在 Arm Advanced SIMD、SVE、SME 上的具体形态。

要点：五类指令：转换（F1CVTL/F2CVTL 升宽、FCVTN 缩窄）、按指数缩放（FSCALE）、宽化乘加（FMLALL 系列，BB/BT/TB/TT 变体）、点积（SME FP8 DOT，32 位元素内打包 4 个 8 位值做融合 FP32 点积）、矩阵乘（SVE FMMLA）与外积（SME2 FMOPA 直接累加进 ZA tile）。计算指令均从 FPMR 读源格式、按 LSCALE/NSCALE 缩放，累加用 FP16/FP32 保持稳定。

关键数字：FMMLA 每 128-bit 段按 2×8 与 8×2 矩阵相乘得 2×2 结果（8-way 点积）；FMOPA 在 SME2 把 FP8 输入直接累加进 FP16/FP32 元素的 ZA tile。

item.title: Part 1: Introduction to Arm FP8 (8-bit floating-point) formats
item.description:
发表方：Arm Community Blog　发布：2026-11-02　分类：技术博客 / 每日精选

核心话题：Arm FEAT_FP8 为什么引入 FP8 格式家族，以及硬件如何支持。

要点：FP8 不是单一格式而是家族：E4M3 偏精度，适合激活与权重；E5M2 偏动态范围，适合梯度。新增 FPMR 浮点模式寄存器，每个源操作数可独立选择 FP8 格式与缩放因子，且可被硬件 rename、接近普通寄存器写入而非串行化控制更新，便于性能关键代码频繁切换 per-tensor 格式。

关键数字：E4M3 为 1 符号位+4 指数位+3 尾数位、bias 7；E5M2 为 1+5+2、bias 15；FP8 规范（OCP OFP8）由 Arm、Intel、NVIDIA 联合发布，NVIDIA H100 已支持。

为什么值得看：理解端侧 FP8 落地的格式设计与寄存器机制，为指令级优化打底。

item.title: PagedMoE: Cross-Precision Expert Caching for Token-Level Dynamic Precision in SSD-Resident MoE Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.AR)　发布：2026-11-02　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 大型 MoE 模型可本地推理，路由专家池驻留 SSD、DRAM 缓存近期专家；但实际缓存容量下 SSD I/O 仍在关键路径，token 级动态精度虽可减少数据需求，独立精度对象使缓存无法跨精度复用、重复取数。

方法 关键洞察：精度应表示同一专家状态的细化深度。PagedMoE 用前缀兼容树码本与 bitplane 布局把每个专家存一次，低精度表示是高精度表示的有效前缀，缓存数据可复用或只取缺失 bitplane 扩展；I/O 前用当前路由权重与离线误差剖面选所需前缀长度，直接执行缓存的 1–8 bit 前缀。

关键数字 平均路由专家精度 2.5 bits 时质量接近 GPTQ-INT4（Qwen3.5-397B-A17B）与 MXFP4（多数 GLM5.2 任务）；24 GiB 专家缓存下 Qwen3.5 达 8.89 tokens/s；吞吐为独立精度对象方案的 1.33 倍、均匀 4-bit 执行的 1.56 倍。

为什么值得看 SSD 驻留超大 MoE 的跨精度缓存复用范式，显著缓解本地推理的存储带宽瓶颈。

item.title: Packet-Based NPUs In The LLM Era: From Compute-Bound CNNs To Memory-Bound Edge And Automotive Workloads
item.description:
发表方：Expedera（Edge AI and Vision Alliance 转载）　发布：2026-11-02　分类：技术博客 / 每日精选

核心话题 边缘 NPU 工作负载从纯计算密集的 CNN 转向带大 KV cache 的、内存密集的 LLM/VLM 推理（尤其在车规安全场景），NPU 设计如何随之改变。

要点 瓶颈反转：CNN 时代权重复用、推理近无状态、优化目标是限定面积功耗下的 MAC 吞吐；LLM/VLM 时代 decode 被 KV cache 访问、低复用大参数集主导，内存行为（cache 大小、访问模式、带宽）取代标称 TOPS 成为限制。Expedera 的 Origin NPU 用"包"代替"层"调度，把该抽象延伸到 transformer 块与 KV cache 访问，按网络结构与 prefill/decode 阶段路由包到前馈/注意力/向量处理块。

关键数字 单核可扩展至 128 TFLOPS、多核至 PetaFLOPS；对 Llama 3.2 1B 与 Qwen2 1.5B，基于包的处理可比替代方案减少 75% 以上的外部内存搬移；高内存受限场景可达"数千有效 TFLOPS"与"每平方毫米硅数十 token/s"。

为什么值得看 业界头部 NPU IP 厂商对"边缘从 CNN 转向 LLM"的第一手架构回应，量化了内存搬移在边缘 LLM 里的决定性地位。

item.title: P$^2$-MOPD: Accelerating Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation via Parameter Priors
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-02　分类：论文PDF

P^2-MOPD：参数先验加速多教师 on-policy 蒸馏，联合优化混合系数与学生权重

Multi-teacher on-policy distillation consolidates expert capabilities by supervising student-generated trajectories, whereas task arithmetic offers a training-free alternative through linear parameter combinations. We view the linear combination of student and expert parameters as a single differentiable model and propose P$^2$-MOPD, which jointly optimizes the mixing coefficients and the student weights under the same on-policy distillation objective. Unlike task arithmetic, which stays within the span of the frozen student and expert parameters for any choice of merging coefficients, P$^2$-MOPD keeps the student trainable, so the experts act as parameter priors without confining it to this span. Across four domains at 1.7B and 4B scales, P$^2$-MOPD achieves faster and more balanced recovery than MOPD from the same initialization, surpassing its final average recovery in half the training steps. At the end of training, our 1.7B model reaches 94.7% average recovery, versus 80.9% for MOPD.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Online Class Posteriors for Interpretable and Controllable Discrete Diffusion
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-02　分类：论文PDF

Discrete diffusion models remain far less understood than their continuous counterparts, despite recent breakthroughs across modalities, most notably in text. Leveraging tools from continuous diffusion, we formulate a theoretical framework to track the class-conditional posterior in an online manner by combining conditional and unconditional model predictions. In masked language modeling, this posterior offers highly interpretable dynamics: tokens aligned with a class boost the posterior, while contradictory ones suppress it. We also show that the posterior can be used for logical guidance operations (AND, OR, NOT) in discrete diffusion. These operations enable precise control over generation, such as avoiding specific classes. In addition, we discuss a mismatch in the formulation of classifier-free guidance between discrete and continuous settings: discrete models mix the data distributions, while continuous models mix the marginals. We validate our methods and discuss their potential applications on synthetic data, with all quantities analytically tractable, as well as on MNIST, text, and antibody sequences.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: OctEx: Billion-Scale Vector Search by Precomputed Lattice Neighbor Lists on GPUs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.DC)　发布：2026-11-02　分类：论文PDF

Approximate nearest-neighbor search on GPUs serves retrieval-augmented generation, recommendation, and deduplication over datasets of up to billions of vectors. The fastest GPU indexes at high recall, such as CAGRA, walk proximity graphs in chained rounds, each of which waits for the distances of the previous one. High recall therefore costs many dependent rounds per query. Our insight is to spend the HBM of the GPUs on precomputed neighbor lists, so that a query reads its candidates in one parallel step instead of a chain of rounds. This paper turns the above insight into a GPU vector search system, namely OctEx, which holds hundreds of randomly projected copies of the dataset in GPU memory. Every copy rounds its vectors to the nearest points of a regular grid whose cells are nearly round and stores for every populated cell the list of vectors nearest to its center. A query reads the lists of its cells in all copies at once and then, in a fixed number of waves, the precomputed neighbor lists of its best hits. OctEx ranks the union of all hits by an int8 sketch before one exact rerank. OctEx runs the whole search of a batch as CUDA graphs over all GPUs of a server and places every …

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: NormMoX: A Normative Mixture of Experts for Explainable Autism Classification from Structural and Functional MRI
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-02　分类：论文PDF

While structural and functional magnetic resonance imaging (sMRI, fMRI) offer profound potential for researching autism spectrum disorder (ASD) and understanding individual neurodivergence, current classifiers lack the explanatory power needed for scientific study, clinical use and personal-level insights. Most models learn from imaging features that also vary with age, sex, scanner site and head motion. They fuse the two modalities without a common reference and explain decisions against arbitrary reference inputs rather than a typical brain. We present NormMoX, a normative mixture of experts that makes the typical brain the shared reference for prediction, fusion and explanation. Normative models trained on large healthy cohorts give the value each brain measure is expected to take for a person's age and sex. NormMoX learns from each person's deviations from these expected values. For each modality, a neural network expert turns the deviations into a score of evidence for ASD. A fusion head, MoX, compares each score with those of typical controls before combining them. It therefore needs no imputation when a modality is missing and shows in which modality each person is atypical.…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Multi-layer Indexer: Overlapping Selection and Attention in DeepSeek Sparse Attention
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-02　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 DeepSeek Sparse Attention（DSA，DeepSeek-V3.2 与 GLM-5 采用）中，每层前面的 lightning indexer 要扫描整个 cache 并保留 k=2048 最高分 token；长上下文下解码时间主要花在 indexer 扫描而非稀疏注意力本身。

方法 观察到相邻层选出的 token 几乎相同，让每层直接复用上一层 indexer 的选择，消除依赖后各层 indexer 可与本层注意力并发执行，即 Multi-layer Indexer（MLI）。无需重训、无新权重，默认实现不改任何内核，运行在 SGLang 生产解码图内；可选融合内核可进一步加速，且与 IndexCache（GLM-5.2 的跨层复用）可组合。

关键数字 在保留率 1/2~1/32、上下文 10K~195K 下：与 IndexCache 同保留率组合，DeepSeek-V3.2 解码快最多 14.5%、GLM-5 快 9.8%（保留率 1/2 时），1/2 保留率下 7.9% 起。

为什么值得看 不重训不动内核就把稀疏注意力中最贵的 indexer 扫描开销藏进并发，直接可落地到生产服务引擎。

item.title: Memory Admission and Result-Retention Sizing in an RV32IMC FPGA Soft Processor
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.AR)　发布：2026-11-02　分类：论文PDF

In FPGA soft processors with shared backing block RAM, memory admission can stall a multiplication after its product has been prepared. We study how admission timing changes result retention in PaceRV, our board-tested five-stage RV32IMC core, using fixed binaries and matched dynamic instructions. Offering data requests one edge earlier reduces geometric-mean Embench cycles by 18.2% and retention opportunities from 375,063 to 4,373. Admission and retention cycle gains are conditional and non-additive. Under slower reads, a 99% capture target selects an 18-edge validity window with registered requests and 28 edges with early requests, although no multiplication matched within both measurement intervals waits longer. A predeclared sizing rule predicts opportunity recovery exactly in all finite tests, including kernels excluded from model development. Independent timing analysis closely estimates execution-cycle savings. The results support choosing admission first, then deciding whether to extend validity and sizing it against an explicit capture or missed-opportunity objective.

item.content:encoded:
发表方：arXiv (cs.AR)　发布：2026-11-02　分类：论文PDF

In FPGA soft processors with shared backing block RAM, memory admission can stall a multiplication after its product has been prepared. We study how admission timing changes result retention in PaceRV, our board-tested five-stage RV32IMC core, using fixed binaries and matched dynamic instructions. Offering data requests one edge earlier reduces geometric-mean Embench cycles by 18.2% and retention opportunities from 375,063 to 4,373. Admission and retention cycle gains are conditional and non-additive. Under slower reads, a 99% capture target selects an 18-edge validity window with registered requests and 28 edges with early requests, although no multiplication matched within both measurement intervals waits longer. A predeclared sizing rule predicts opportunity recovery exactly in all finite tests, including kernels excluded from model development. Independent timing analysis closely estimates execution-cycle savings. The results support choosing admission first, then deciding whether to extend validity and sizing it against an explicit capture or missed-opportunity objective.

item.title: MBUndo: Sound, Automatic, and Efficient Measurement-Based Uncomputation for Quantum Circuits
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.PL)　发布：2026-11-02　分类：论文PDF

Quantum programs that use temporary values, known as \emph{ancilla} qubits, must explicitly \emph{uncompute} each ancilla back to zero to ensure that the program produces correct outputs. Conventional uncomputation uses unitary quantum gates, whereas leading quantum algorithms now leverage \emph{measurement-based uncomputation} (MBU), which replaces costly unitary $T$ gates with cheaper measurements and phase corrections. Current quantum programming frameworks can use measurement to uncompute specific gates such as Toffoli. No automatic transformation, however, accepts an arbitrary circuit whose ancillas are computed and uncomputed via the standard approach and converts the circuit to use MBU\@. Researchers instead apply MBU to individual circuit designs by hand, which limits algorithm development and compiler optimization. Such a transformation has not existed due to two fundamental unknowns: where MBU applies and which gates realize MBU for an arbitrary computation. To solve these, we first present a static analysis that identifies, for each ancilla qubit, each circuit position where measurement is sound --- subsuming basic assumptions that MBU only applies at the end of a circui…

item.title: M3Former: Fine-Grained Cross-Layer Mixing for Transformers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-02　分类：论文PDF

Residual connections give each Transformer block access to all earlier layers only through one fixed sum, broadcast to all of the block's inputs. This broadcast bottleneck imposes three constraints: the query, key, value and residual inputs of a block, which we call its roles, read the same vector; all hidden dimensions within a role share one set of weights over earlier layers; and every earlier layer has the same fixed weight for every token. We propose the Multi-Role Multi-Group Mixing Residual (M3), which removes all three: every role, and every group of hidden dimensions within a role, reads its own token-dependent mixture of all earlier layers. M3 starts as an exact residual connection and adds as little as 1.4% parameters and 1.8% FLOPs. From 100M to 1.4B parameters, M3Former outperforms the Transformer and coarse-grained cross-layer connections at every size, matching a Transformer 1.19-1.34x the size of the one it modifies, trained with 1.4-1.8x the compute. Relaxing only some of the constraints recovers only part of this gain. M3Former also improves sparse mixture-of-experts models of up to 4.6B parameters and trains more stably in deeper networks. item.title: Local Zero-Shot Latency Prediction for Low-End GPUs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.DC)　发布：2026-11-02　分类：论文PDF

Quantifying execution latency is an important consideration across Machine Learning. Existing latency-prediction approaches typically train ML models on traces collected from workload execution on target hardware. Collection of representative traces across many consumer GPUs is expensive both in organizing the devices and in manpower, causing existing work to mainly focus on a limited set of high-end GPUs available in cloud computing. To offset this cost, we show that a local host GPU can be configured to reproduce the execution performance of less powerful target GPUs. Through selectively modifying device parameters, we obtain locally measured latencies that closely approximate those observed on the target hardware. We reformulate the latency-prediction task: instead of fitting a prediction model to a dataset of execution traces, we identify local configurations that best reproduce target devices' performance, enabling zero-shot prediction. We evaluate our approach against real measurements from 60 computer-vision models executed on 21 consumer GPU models. Our method achieves a mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) of 14.21%, compared with more than 25% for comparable baselines, r…

item.title: Library of Layers (LoL): Adaptively Ordering Transformer Layers at Runtime
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-02　分类：论文PDF

Computer programmers chain together the same reusable computational primitives, for example, conditional statements or loops, but in different orders to implement different algorithms. In contrast, existing language model architectures always execute their layers in the same order. We introduce Library of Layers (LoL), an architecture that dynamically orders its layers during inference to solve the problem at hand. LoL has a single hyperparameter, the size of its global library of transformer blocks, that allows it to transition seamlessly between parameter reuse and sparsity, generalizing the parameter-efficiency and FLOPs-efficiency tradeoffs of dense, depth-recurrent, and mixture of experts architectures in one unified family. We show that LoL achieves competitive performance with all three above baselines when pretrained on text data. On synthetic sudoku and maze data, we observe that the model employs distinct layer orderings to implement different solution strategies, and we can intervene on routing to force a model to apply a specific solution strategy to a problem instance. In a multilingual natural language setting, we find that LoL chooses different layer order patterns b…

item.title: Language Models Can Benefit from Domain-Specific Inductive Biases
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-02　分类：论文PDF

语言模型可从领域特定归纳偏置获益：跨预训练数据子集的架构有效性实证

Language models are typically trained with a single choice of architecture on diverse domains and data sources. Modern transformers have been extensively refined for such general-purpose learning, but are they equally effective across different subsets of the pretraining data? We investigate this question by training small language models from scratch on representative subsets of pretraining data such as web text, code, and mathematics. We introduce variants of transformers in which standard activation functions are replaced with learned splines tuned on specific datasets, providing a simple way to modify their inductive biases. Using a mix-and-match of architectures and datasets, we evaluate cross-domain transfer, i.e. how well does an architecture tuned for one domain perform on data from another? We find that the tuned transformer variants improve training efficiency or generalization on all seven of our tested datasets, but the gains are often domain-specific. For example, architectures tuned on a natural language dataset such as FineWeb perform well on TinyStories, whereas those tuned on mathematics perform poorly on natural language. item.title: LaBraM at Scale: Scaling Data and Models for EEG Pretraining
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-02　分类：论文PDF

LaBraM, an early EEG foundation model, demonstrated that large-scale EEG pretraining can yield strong representations for diverse downstream tasks. Building on this foundation, we expand pretraining data and model capacity while retaining its core encoder and objective. We train ten encoders with 5.8 million to 1.97 billion parameters on three EEG collections spanning 25,067 to 79,910 hours, adapting signal preparation and training to heterogeneous recordings. Across 23 tasks, Atom-L* reaches 59.05% mean balanced accuracy at its best evaluated full fine-tuning (Full-FT) checkpoint, 3.61 percentage points above the strongest baseline EEG foundation model. Quark-G leads linear probing (LP) at 54.33%, a 1.24-point margin. Both also lead average task rank. At the last evaluated checkpoints, larger encoders improve Full-FT more consistently than LP, and stronger LP does not guarantee stronger Full-FT. Preserving patch structure improves LP over average pooling. Data-fraction experiments suggest capacity-dependent saturation, while checkpoint trajectories show that downstream performance can decline as pretraining loss falls. item.title: LLMs Depend on Specialist Tools for Out-of-Distribution Generalization in MS/MS Structural Elucidation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-02　分类：论文PDF

A frontier language model was recently reported to solve 1D NMR structural elucidation without tools. We ask whether this capability transfers to tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS) in the de novo setting, where the model must propose a structure directly from the spectrum without a candidate list or reference library. To separate reasoning from recall, we build a 100-analyte benchmark from MassSpecGym, split by each analyte's textual footprint into in-distribution (well documented in literature) and out-of-distribution (essentially undocumented) arms. We hold the model, harness, and output format fixed and vary only the LLM's access to domain-specific tools. Without tools, a frontier LLM reaches 52% Top-1 accuracy in-distribution but only 2% out-of-distribution. Only access to de novo structure generators improves out-of-distribution accuracy, raising it to as much as 38% Top-1, and the resulting agent outperforms the standalone de novo models both in and out of distribution. These results suggest that LLMs are not effective at de novo MS/MS structural elucidation on their own, and that further gains depend on the specialist tools available to the agent rather than on the LLM itself.

item.title: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks vs. Multi-Layer Perceptrons: A Rigorous Statistical Benchmark on Clinical Tabular Data
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-02　分类：论文PDF

Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) have recently been proposed as a promising alternative to Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs). However, empirical evaluations on structured medical datasets remain scarce, and commonly reported metrics like AUROC can yield overly optimistic performance estimates on imbalanced clinical cohorts. In this study, we present a standardized benchmark comparing eleven architectures - nine KAN variants (FastKAN, WavKAN, ReLUKAN, ChebyKAN, TaylorKAN, GramKAN, JacobiKAN, LegendreKAN, and TabKAN), a tuned StandardMLP, and a Random Forest baseline - across seven heterogeneous medical tabular datasets spanning oncology, cardiology, nephrology, neurology, endocrinology, and obstetrics. Our experimental protocol employs a 3x5 Repeated Stratified K-Fold cross-validation scheme with nested Bayesian hyperparameter optimization and evaluates discrimination via Area Under the Precision-Recall Curve (AUPRC), calibration through the Brier Score, and computational efficiency. Formal equivalence testing is conducted using the Bayesian Correlated t-Test with a Region of Practical Equivalence (ROPE) at +/- 0.01. item.title: Iterated Narrow Networks: Turing Completeness at Width 4 on Convex Input Spaces and the Complexity of Verification
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-02　分类：论文PDF

We study the iterates of a fixed ReLU network $N$ of width 4, that is, the discrete-time system $x_{k+1} = N(x_k)$ on $[0,1]^4$. Equivalently, $x_k$ is the output of a weight-tied network made of $k$ copies of $N$, or of a recurrent network with no external input, started at $x_0$. We prove that every deterministic Turing machine $M$ admits such a network $N_M$. The network can be constructed in polynomial time from $M$. Each iteration has depth $\mathrm{poly}(|M|)$. The iterates of $N_M$ simulate $M$ exactly on every encoded tape. The number of iterations is proportional to the running time of $M$. Moreover, the fourth coordinate irreversibly flags every point of the convex cube $[0,1]^4$ whose simulation reads an invalid digit. This flag is the certificate that makes hardness reductions sound on convex input regions, the regime of practical verifiers. Convex regions were previously inaccessible because of a continuity obstruction inherent to ReLU networks. The correspondence has three consequences. First, reachability for iterated width-4 ReLU networks spans the full complexity hierarchy along the single axis of the time bound: it is NP-complete for a unary bound, NEXP-complete f…
